name: 4. The Caste Disabilities Removal West Pakistan Amendment Act 1963 , 1963

metadata.title: The Caste Disabilities Removal (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1963
metadata.amends: Caste Disabilities Removal Act, 1850
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Caste Disabilities Removal Act of 1850 to apply specifically to the Province of West Pakistan. It adds a proviso to section 1 of the 1850 Act excluding inheritance rights for Muslims from its application.

name: Al- Hamd University Act 2005.doc , 2005

metadata.title: The Al-Hamd Islamic University, Quetta Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Al-Hamd Islamic University at Quetta as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Chancellor, Rector, and Board of Governors, and outlines its powers to provide instruction, conduct examinations, award degrees, and pursue research.

name: Al- Hamd University Act 2005 , 2005

metadata.title: The Al-Hamd Islamic University, Quetta Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Al-Hamd Islamic University at Quetta as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Chancellor, Rector, and Board of Governors, and outlines its powers to provide instruction, conduct examinations, award degrees, and pursue research.

name: Archives Act 2014 , 2014

metadata.title: The Balochistan Archives Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the custody and preservation of public records and archival materials of historical significance to Balochistan. It establishes the Balochistan Archives, defines key terms such as 'public record' and 'Director', and outlines the management duties of the Director including the conservation of records and establishment of divisional offices.

name: Bal Sport Board Act 2009.doc , 2009

metadata.title: The Balochistan Sports Board Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Balochistan Sports Board as a body corporate with perpetual succession to oversee sports activities in the province. It defines the Board's composition, including government officials, nominated members, and public representatives, while outlining its powers, functions, and financial management structures.

name: Bal Employees’ Efficiency and Discipline Act 2011(S&GAD) , 2011

metadata.title: The Balochistan Employees' Efficiency and Discipline Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act provides for proceedings against employees in Government, autonomous bodies, authorities, and corporation services regarding their efficiency, discipline, and accountability. It establishes grounds for penalties, outlines inquiry procedures, defines the powers of competent authorities and inquiry officers, and sets rules for appeals and revisions.

name: Bal Enquiries and Anti Corruption Act, 2010 , 2010

metadata.title: The Balochistan Enquiries and Anti-Corruption Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a special agency known as the Enquiries and Anti-Corruption Establishment to investigate corruption offences and misconduct by public servants in Balochistan. It grants specific powers for search, arrest, and seizure of property to members of this establishment during preliminary enquiries or investigations.

name: Bal Holy Quran (Printing and Recording) Act 2015 (relogious Affair) , 2015

metadata.title: The Balochistan Holy Quran (Printing and Recording) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act ensures the publication of the Holy Quran text free from printing and recording errors within Balochistan. It also establishes provisions for the proper disposal of damaged or 'Shaheed' copies to maintain their sanctity.

name: Bal Holy Quran (Printing and Recording) Act 2015(relogious Affair) , 2015

metadata.title: The Balochistan Holy Quran (Printing and Recording) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act ensures the publication of the Holy Quran text free from printing and recording errors within Balochistan. It also establishes provisions for the proper disposal of damaged or 'Shaheed' copies to maintain their sanctity.

name: Bal Industrial Relations Act 2010 , 2010

metadata.title: The Balochistan Industrial Relations Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and rationalizes the law regarding the formation of trade unions in Balochistan. It also aims to improve relations between employers and workmen while providing mechanisms for resolving industrial disputes.

name: Bal Pension Fund Management Authority Act, 2009 (Baln Act IX of 2009) , 2009

metadata.title: The Balochistan Pension Fund Management Authority Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Balochistan Pension Fund Management Authority to manage pension funds for government employees. It provides a legal framework for generating revenue to discharge pension liabilities and outlines the composition, powers, and functions of the management board.

name: Bal Provincial Employees Group Insurance Act, 2009 , 2009

metadata.title: The Balochistan Provincial Employees Group Insurance Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Board of Trustees to regulate group insurance for the provincial employees of the Government of Balochistan. It provides for the creation of an Insurance Fund, the arrangement with insurance companies, and the mechanisms for paying premiums and sums assured.

name: Bal Provincial Employees Group Insurance Act, 2009 (Baln Act X of 2009) , 2009

metadata.title: The Balochistan Provincial Employees Group Insurance Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Board of Trustees to regulate group insurance for the provincial employees of the Government of Balochistan. It provides for the creation of an Insurance Fund, the arrangement with insurance companies, and the mechanisms for paying premiums and sums assured.

name: Bal Sound Systems (Regulation) Act II of 2016 , 2016

metadata.title: The Balochistan Sound Systems (Regulation) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act regulates and controls the use of sound systems in Balochistan to prevent public nuisance and maintain public order. It prohibits the use of loudspeakers that generate unnecessary noise or disturb peace, particularly near places of worship, hospitals, and educational institutions.

name: Bal Technical Education & Vocational Training Authority Act 2011.doc , 2011

metadata.title: The Balochistan Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority of Balochistan to regulate and promote vocational training and technical education. It provides for the financing of training programmes and matters connected thereto.

name: Bal Wildlife (Protection) Act 2014 , 2014

metadata.title: The Balochistan Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection, preservation, conservation, and sustainable management of wildlife in the Province of Balochistan. It also establishes the framework for the creation and management of protected areas within the province.

name: Bal Witness Protection Act IV of 2016 , 2016

metadata.title: The Balochistan Witness Protection Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Witness Protection Program in the Province of Balochistan to enable witnesses to give evidence in criminal proceedings safely. It creates a dedicated Protection Unit headed by a Chief Witness and outlines the powers, functions, and duties of officers involved in protecting witnesses and their related persons.

name: Baln Ordinance X of 1984 , 1984

metadata.title: The Excise Regulation (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Excise Regulation, 1915
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Excise Regulation of 1915 specifically for the Province of Balochistan. It adds a new section prohibiting the issuance of any excise licenses or permits to Muslims.

name: Baln Culture Heritage Act, 2010 (Baln Act X of 2010) , 2010

metadata.title: The Balochistan Cultural Heritage Preservation Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the preservation and protection of ancient places and objects of architectural, historical, archaeological, artistic, ethnological, anthropological, and national interest in Balochistan. It establishes an Advisory Committee to assist the Government and outlines procedures for declaring protected heritage, acquiring rights, and maintaining these sites.

name: Baln Finance Act, 1966 , 1966

metadata.title: The Balochistan Finance Act, 1966
metadata.summary: This Act continues and levies certain taxes and duties in the Province of Balochistan. It establishes specific surcharges on agricultural income-tax, cinema tickets, motor vehicles, railway fares, and tolls for inland vessels.

name: Baln Finance Act, 1967 , 1967

metadata.title: The Balochistan Finance Act, 1967
metadata.amends: The Balochistan Finance Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act continues and levies various taxes and duties in the Province of Balochistan, including surcharges on agricultural income-tax, cinema taxes, motor vehicle taxes, and railway fare taxes. It also amends existing laws regarding stamp duties and sugar mill cesses while establishing penalties for non-payment and barring civil suits against tax assessments.

name: Baln General Provident Investment Fund Act, 1 of 2007 , 2007

metadata.title: The Balochistan General Provident Investment Fund Act, 2007
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a General Provident Investment Fund for government servants in the Province of Balochistan. It outlines the control and management of the fund by a specific Board, details the composition of that Board, and sets provisions for auditing accounts and making rules.

name: Baln General Provident Investment Fund Act, 1 of 2007 , 2007

metadata.title: The Balochistan General Provident Investment Fund Act, 2007
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a General Provident Investment Fund for government servants in the Province of Balochistan. It outlines the control and management of the fund by a specific Board, details the composition of that Board, and sets provisions for auditing accounts and making rules.

name: Baln Institute of Nephro Urology Quetta Act 2015 , 2015

metadata.title: The Balochistan Institute of Nephro Urology Quetta Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Balochistan Institute of Nephro Urology, Quetta, along with affiliated teaching hospitals and centers in the province. It outlines the institute's objects, which include providing renal healthcare services, conducting medical research, and training health professionals.

name: Baln Introduction of Mother Languages as Compulsory Add: Subject at Primary Level Act, 2014 , 2014

metadata.title: The Balochistan Introduction of Mother Languages as Compulsory Additional Subject at Primary Level Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides measures to introduce mother tongues as a compulsory additional subject at the primary level in Balochistan. It mandates the government to supply textbooks, train teachers, and promote these languages alongside national and international languages.

name: Baln Requisitioning of immovable property (Temp Powers) Act 1956 , 1956

metadata.title: The (Balochistan) Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Act, 1956
metadata.repeals: certain Acts and Ordinance
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the temporary requisitioning of immovable property by the Provincial Government when deemed necessary. It outlines procedures for issuing requisition orders, defining terms like 'Building' and 'Owner', specifying conditions under which buildings cannot be requisitioned (e.g., religious sites), and establishing rules for compensation and release from requisition.

name: Baln Revenue Authority Act VII 2015 , 2015

metadata.title: The Balochistan Revenue Authority Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Balochistan Revenue Authority to reform and modernize the taxation system. It provides for the establishment of a progressive and professionally efficient tax management organization while offering assistance to taxpayers and promoting compliance with fiscal laws.

name: Baln Sale Tax Act VI 2015 , 2015

metadata.title: The Balochistan Sales Tax on Services Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy of a tax on services provided, rendered, initiated, received, originated, executed, or consumed in Balochistan. It establishes the legal framework including definitions, scope of tax, payment procedures, registration requirements, and penalties for non-compliance.

name: Baln Sales Tax on Service Act, 2015 , 2015

metadata.title: The Balochistan Sales Tax on Services Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy of a tax on services provided, rendered, initiated, received, originated, executed, or consumed in Balochistan. It establishes the scope of the tax, registration requirements, payment procedures, and mechanisms for appeals and recovery of arrears.

name: Baln Transplantation of Human Organ and Tissues Act, 2010 , 2010

metadata.title: The Balochistan Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation, removal, storage, and transplantation of human organs and tissues strictly for therapeutic purposes. It establishes legal definitions for terms such as 'brain dead', 'donor', and 'transplantation', while setting out provisions for voluntary donation by living persons and authorization for post-mortem donation.

name: Baln Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues (Amendment) Act, 2012 , 2012

metadata.title: The Balochistan Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act, 2010
metadata.repeals: The Balochistan Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues (Amendment) Ordinance, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act, 2010 to adapt it for the province of Balochistan. It substitutes references to the Federal Government with the Government of Balochistan and establishes a specific Monitoring Authority composed of various medical and administrative officials.

name: Baln. Private Educational Institution Authority Act, 2015 , 2015

metadata.title: The Balochistan Private Educational Institution Registration and Regulation Authority Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Balochistan Private Educational Institution Registration and Regulation Authority to oversee private educational institutions in the province. It provides a legal framework for the promotion, regulation, registration, and functioning of these institutions while ensuring transparency and discipline.

name: Balochistan Agricultural Research Board Act, 1998.doc , 1998

metadata.title: The Balochistan Agriculture Research Board Act, 1998
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution and organization of the Balochistan Agricultural Research Board. It establishes the Board as a body corporate with powers to plan, program, and evaluate agricultural research within the province.

name: Balochistan Agricultural Solarization and Electricity Theft Prevention Act, 2025 , 2025

metadata.title: The Balochistan Agricultural Solarization and Electricity Theft Prevention Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the transition of agricultural electricity consumers from subsidized supply to solar energy within Balochistan. It implements government solarization agreements and prevents unauthorized reconnections to the electricity distribution network while criminalizing electricity theft.

name: Balochistan Alternate Dispute Resolution Act, 2021 , 2021

metadata.title: The Balochistan Alternate Dispute Resolution Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a system for the alternate dispute resolution of both civil and criminal disputes in Balochistan. It aims to ensure inexpensive and expeditious justice by allowing courts to refer cases to ADR processes such as mediation and conciliation.

name: Balochistan Antiqueties Act 2014 , 2014

metadata.title: The Balochistan Antiquities Act, 2014
metadata.repeals: the Antiquity Act, 1975 (Act VII of 1976)
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the preservation and protection of antiquities within the Province of Balochistan. It establishes an Advisory Committee, defines various terms related to antiquities, and outlines regulations regarding their custody, acquisition, export, and dealing.

name: Balochistan Board of Technical and Vocational Education Act, 2021 , 2021

metadata.title: The Balochistan Board of Technical and Vocational Education Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Balochistan Board of Technical and Vocational Education as an independent body. Its primary purpose is to hold, conduct examinations, and assess technical and vocational qualifications for occupational skills within Balochistan.

name: Balochistan CM and P-Minister (S,A and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 2019 , 2019

metadata.title: The Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers (Salaries, Allowances & Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: The Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 to regulate the official use of government aircraft and helicopters. It grants the Chief Minister permission to use or hire such vehicles for official purposes and allows other designated officials to utilize them under specific conditions.

name: Balochistan Domestic Violence (Prevention and Protection) Act, 2014 , 2014

metadata.title: The Balochistan Domestic Violence (Prevention and Protection) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides legal provisions to protect women, children, and vulnerable persons from domestic violence within a household. It establishes mechanisms for obtaining protection orders, residence orders, monetary relief, and custody arrangements through designated courts.

name: Balochistan Employee's Efficiency and Discipline (Amendment) Act, 2016 , 2016

metadata.title: The Balochistan Employees' Efficiency and Discipline (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.amends: The Balochistan Employees' Efficiency and Discipline Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This document is an Act of the Balochistan Provincial Assembly that amends the existing Balochistan Employees' Efficiency and Discipline Act, 2011. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly on September 24, 2016, and received assent from the Governor on October 4, 2016.

name: Balochistan Finance Act 1968 , 1968

metadata.title: The Balochistan Finance Act, 1968
metadata.amends: The Balochistan Finance Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act continues and levies certain taxes and surcharges in the Province of Balochistan. It establishes specific rates for agricultural income-tax surcharges, cinema taxes, motor vehicle taxes, and railway fare taxes for the financial year 1968-69.

name: Balochistan Fisheries Ordinanace , 1961

metadata.title: The Balochistan Fisheries Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to fisheries in the Province of Balochistan. It establishes regulations regarding the appointment of inspectors, leasing of water for fishing, issuance of permits, prohibited methods of catching fish, and penalties for offences.

name: Balochistan Food stuffs (Control) Act, 1958 , 1958

metadata.title: The Balochistan Foodstuffs (Control) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuance of powers to control the supply, distribution, and movement of foodstuffs in Balochistan. It empowers the Government to regulate trade, commerce, storage, and pricing of specified commodities like wheat, rice, and sugar through notified orders.

name: Balochistan Foodstuffs wholesale and Retail Dealers (Cancellation of Authorizations), 1979 , 1979

metadata.title: The Balochistan Foodstuffs Whole-Sale and Retail Dealers (Cancellation of Authorizations) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the cancellation of authorizations granted for the whole-sale and retail distribution of foodstuffs in Balochistan. It empowers specific government officials to cancel these authorizations if they were granted without merit or if the holder committed malpractice, without paying any compensation.

name: Balochistan Forensic Science Agency Act, 2015 , 2015

metadata.title: The Balochistan Forensic Science Agency Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Balochistan Forensic Science Agency to conduct forensic examinations of documents, materials, and objects. It defines the agency's functions, including rendering expert opinions for courts and tribunals, maintaining records, and promoting awareness in forensic science.

name: Balochistan Freedum of Information Act, 2005 , 2005

metadata.title: The Freedom of Information Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act provides for transparency and freedom of information to ensure citizens of Balochistan have improved access to public records. It aims to make the Government more accountable to its citizens by establishing procedures for requesting information, maintaining records, and designating officials to handle applications.

name: Balochistan Govt Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2007 , 2007

metadata.title: The Balochistan Government Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2007
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Balochistan Government Servants Housing Foundation to provide housing plots on a no-profit, no-loss basis to government servants and their families. It defines the composition of the Board of Directors, outlines the powers and functions of the Foundation, and sets rules for land allocation, fund management, and membership.

name: Balochistan Health Foundation Act, 1994 , 1994

metadata.title: The Balochistan Health Foundation Act, 1994
metadata.repeals: Ordinance No. IV of 1993
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Balochistan Health Foundation to promote and finance health service development in the Province of Balochistan. It defines the foundation as a body corporate with perpetual succession, outlines the constitution and duties of its Board of Directors, and provides for its management, finance, and penalties.

name: Balochistan Hotels Restriction (Security) Act 2015 , 2015

metadata.title: The Balochistan Hotels Restriction (Security) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a mechanism to monitor hotels and guests in the province of Balochistan for counter-terrorism and crime prevention purposes. It mandates that hotel owners, lessees, or managers verify guest credentials using NADRA systems, maintain records, check baggage for explosives, and submit daily guest information to local police stations.

name: Balochistan Industrial Relations (Amendment) Act, 2015 , 2015

metadata.title: The Balochistan Industrial Relations (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Balochistan Industrial Relations Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Balochistan Industrial Relations Act, 2010 to update definitions regarding industries and modify provisions related to trade unions and collective bargaining units. It introduces new sections for authorizing Registrar powers, establishing appeal procedures to the Labour Appellate Tribunal, and detailing the determination of collective bargaining units.

name: Balochistan Infrastructure Development Cess Act, 2019 , 2019

metadata.title: The Balochistan Infrastructure Development Cess Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy and collection of a cess on goods entering or leaving the Province of Balochistan from or for outside the country via rail, road, air, and sea. The collected funds are designated for the development and maintenance of provincial infrastructure.

name: Balochistan Institute of Textile Technology Cess Act, 1962 , 1962

metadata.title: The Balochistan Institute of Textile Technology Cess Act, 1962
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the raising of funds to establish and maintain the Pakistan Institute of Textile Technology in Lyallpur. It authorizes the government to levy a cess on textile mills based on installed spindles and power-looms, outlines assessment procedures, and establishes mechanisms for appeals and recovery.

name: Balochistan Levies Force Act 2010 , 2010

metadata.title: The Balochistan Levies Force Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act reconstructs and regulates the Balochistan Levies Force to maintain law and order in the province. It establishes the force's constitution, command structure, duties, and powers while defining specific operational areas known as A-Area and B-Area.

name: Balochistan Local Government Act 2010 , 2010

metadata.title: The Balochistan Local Government Act, 2010
metadata.repeals: The Balochistan Local Government Act, 1979
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for local councils in Balochistan, covering their constitution, composition, and election processes. It outlines the executive powers, administration of services, functions, development planning, finance, property management, taxation, and supervision mechanisms for these councils.

name: Balochistan Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2017 , 2017

metadata.title: The Balochistan Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Balochistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Balochistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to update penalty rates for various traffic and parking violations. It substitutes specific sections in the original Ordinance and introduces a new Twelfth Schedule detailing fines for offenses ranging from speeding to driving without insurance.

name: Balochistan Police Act 2011 , 2011

metadata.title: The Balochistan Police Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act reconstructs and regulates the police establishment in Balochistan to make it a more efficient instrument for crime prevention and detection. It defines the constitution of the police force, the roles of the Inspector General and District Magistrate, and outlines powers regarding public assemblies and investigations.

name: Balochistan Private Hospitals Regulatory Act, 2004 , 2004

metadata.title: The Balochistan Private Hospital Regulatory Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the establishment, accreditation, licensing, control, and supervision of private hospitals in the Province of Balochistan. It establishes District Hospital Regulatory Boards to oversee these functions and defines key terms related to hospital operations and personnel.

name: Balochistan Residential College Act, 2005.doc , 2005

metadata.title: The Balochistan Residential Colleges Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of Residential Colleges in Balochistan and creates a Board of Governors to manage them. It defines the composition, powers, and functions of the Board, including authority over property, staff appointments, and student admissions.

name: Balochistan Revenue Authority Act VII 2015 , 2015

metadata.title: The Balochistan Revenue Authority Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Balochistan Revenue Authority as a body corporate to reform and modernize the taxation system in Balochistan. It provides for the establishment, powers, functions, and management structure of the Authority, including provisions for tax assessment, collection, and compliance.

name: Balochistan Sales Tax on Services Act, 2015 , 2015

metadata.title: The Balochistan Sales Tax on Services Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy of a tax on services provided, rendered, initiated, received, originated, executed, or consumed in Balochistan. It establishes the scope of the tax, registration requirements, payment procedures, and mechanisms for appeals and recovery of arrears.

name: Balochistan Subordinate Judiciary Service Tribunal Act, 1989 , 1989

metadata.title: The Balochistan Subordinate Judiciary Service Tribunal Act, 1989
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Service Tribunal to exercise exclusive jurisdiction over matters relating to the terms and conditions of service for members of the subordinate judiciary in Balochistan. The Tribunal is empowered to hear appeals against departmental orders, confirm or set aside such orders, and possesses the powers of a civil court for conducting inquiries.

name: Balochistan University of BUITEMS (Amendment) Act, 2015 , 2015

metadata.title: The Balochistan University of Information Technology Engineering & Management Sciences (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Balochistan University of Information Technology and Management Sciences Quetta Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Balochistan University of Information Technology and Management Sciences Quetta Ordinance, 2002. It introduces changes to the university's name, establishes the position of Pro-Vice Chancellor, and modifies the composition and powers of the Senate.

name: Balochistan University of Engineering and Technology (Amendment) Act, 2015 , 2015

metadata.title: The Balochistan University of Engineering and Technology (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Balochistan University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Balochistan University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1994 to introduce new roles such as Pro-Vice Chancellor and modify the composition and powers of the Senate. It establishes specific appointment processes for university leadership and defines the Chancellor's authority over Senate proceedings and management irregularities.

name: Balochistan Women Protection Act, 2016 , 2016

metadata.title: The Balochistan Protection Against Harassment of Women at Workplace Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection of women against harassment at the workplace in Balochistan. It establishes mechanisms including an Inquiry Committee and an Ombudsperson to handle complaints and defines the responsibilities of employers.

name: Bolan University of Medical & Health Sciences Act, 2017.doc , 2017

metadata.title: The Bolan University of Medical and Health Sciences Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Bolan University of Medical and Health Sciences with its main campus in Quetta. It aims to coordinate medical, nursing, and paramedical education under one roof while advancing health research and facilities within the province.

name: Borstal Institutions Act 2014 , 2014

metadata.title: The Balochistan Borstal Institutions Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment and regulation of Borstal Institutions in Balochistan for the detention, education, and training of juveniles. It outlines the administration, appointment of staff, powers of courts regarding juvenile offenders, and measures for the rehabilitation and mental development of inmates.

name: Chakar Khan University Act, 2018.doc , 2018

metadata.title: Mir Chakar Khan Rind University, Sibi Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Mir Chakar Khan Rind University at Sibi in the Province of Balochistan to meet the high demand for higher education in that area. It provides for the university's constitution, incorporation, powers, purposes, and the establishment of various authorities such as the Senate, Syndicate, and Academic Council.

name: Charitable funds Regulation of Collection West Pakistan amendmetn act 1967 , 1963

metadata.title: The Charitable Funds (Regulation of Collections) (West Pakistan Amendment and Extension) Act, 1967
metadata.amends: The Charitable Funds (Regulation of Collections) Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Charitable Funds (Regulation of Collections) Act, 1953 by extending its application to the whole of West Pakistan except Tribal Areas. It substitutes and amends various sections of the 1953 Act to replace references to the Commissioner with the Government and to clarify definitions regarding government authority and religious shrines.

name: Civilian Victims of Terrorism (Relief and Rehabilitation) Act 2014 , 2014

metadata.title: The Balochistan Civilian Victims of Terrorism (Relief and Rehabilitation) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes an institutionalized response to provide relief and rehabilitation for civilian victims of terrorist acts in Balochistan. It creates a specific fund, defines the rights of victims including healthcare and livelihood support, and outlines procedures for ascertaining victims and making payments.

name: Code of Civil Procedure (Balochistan Amendment) Act, 2019 , 2019

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure (Balochistan Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: The Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 as it applies to the Province of Balochistan. It introduces various changes including substituting 'Small Claims' for 'Small Causes', omitting specific sections, and modifying provisions related to judgments, appeals, and execution proceedings.

name: Code of Criminal Procedure (West Pakistan Amendment)ACT, 1968 , 1968

metadata.title: The Code of Criminal Procedure (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1968
metadata.amends: The Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. Specifically, it substitutes the word 'Bailable' with 'Not bailable' in Schedule II against sections 325 and 435 of the Pakistan Penal Code.

name: Compulsory Education Act 2014 , 2014

metadata.title: The Balochistan Compulsory Education Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for free and compulsory education in the Province of Balochistan, except the Tribal Areas. It establishes Parent Teacher School Management Committees to oversee school administration and enforce attendance, while defining key terms such as 'child', 'education', and 'free education'.

name: Consumers Protection Act 2003 , 2003

metadata.title: The Balochistan Consumer Protection Act, 2003
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the promotion and protection of consumer interests within the Province of Balochistan. It establishes a Consumers Protection Council, creates Consumer Courts with specific jurisdiction, and outlines obligations for manufacturers regarding prices, receipts, and advertising.

name: Defence Housing Authority Quetta Act 2015 , 2015

metadata.title: The Defence Housing Authority Quetta Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Defence Housing Authority Quetta as a body corporate to provide quality living and working environments for defence personnel in Balochistan. It outlines the establishment, management structure, powers, and functions of the Authority, including its role in land development and welfare schemes for martyrs' families.

name: Food Authority Act, 2014 , 2014

metadata.title: The Balochistan Food Authority Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Balochistan Food Authority to regulate food safety and standards within the province. It defines key terms related to food, outlines the authority's composition and powers, and prescribes penalties for offenses such as selling adulterated or unsafe food.

name: Forest West Pakistan Amendment Ordinance 1962 , 1962

metadata.title: The Forest (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: The Forest Act, 1927
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Forest Act, 1927 as it applies to specific parts of West Pakistan. It substitutes the word 'vehicles' for the word 'carts' wherever the latter occurs in the Act.

name: Gawadar University Act, 2018 , 2018

metadata.title: The University of Gwadar Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Gwadar in Balochistan by upgrading the existing Gwadar Campus of the University of Turbat. It provides for the university's constitution, incorporation, powers, and the establishment of various authorities such as the Senate and Syndicate.

name: GIEDA Act No. II of 2009 , 2009

metadata.title: Gwadar Industrial Estates Development Authority Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Gwadar Industrial Estates Development Authority (GIEDA) to promote and develop industrial estates in District Gwadar, Balochistan. It defines the Authority as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its structure, including the Board of Directors and the Managing Director.

name: Gwadar Development Authority Act, 2003 , 2003

metadata.title: The Gwadar Development Authority Act, 2003
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Gwadar Development Authority to plan, develop, improve, and construct in the Gwadar area. It defines the Authority as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its management structure through a Governing Body.

name: Health Thalassemia Act 2015 , 2015

metadata.title: The Balochistan Prevention and Control of Thalassemia Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention and control of Thalassemia in the Province of Balochistan. It establishes obligations for the government to create diagnostic facilities, mandates pre-marital blood screening for relatives of patients, and sets penalties for non-compliance.

name: Hotels and Restaurants Act 2014 , 2014

metadata.title: The Balochistan Hotels and Restaurants Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides measures to control and regulate the standards of service and amenities for tourists in hotels and restaurants within Balochistan. It establishes a regulatory framework including the appointment of a Director, registration requirements, classification of establishments, and provisions for fair rates and penalties for offences.

name: The Balochistan Alternate Dispute Resolution Act, 2022 , 2022

metadata.title: The Balochistan Alternative Dispute Resolution Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a system for the alternate resolution of civil and criminal disputes in Balochistan to ensure inexpensive and expeditious justice. It provides mechanisms for courts to refer cases to ADR centers, defines key terms like mediation and conciliation, and sets time limits for completing ADR proceedings before trials resume.

name: The Balochistan Alternative Dispute Resolution Act, 2022 (Amendment-2024) , 2024

metadata.title: The Balochistan Alternative Dispute Resolution (Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.amends: The Balochistan Alternate Dispute Resolution Act, 2022

name: The Balochistan Amendment of Laws Repeal Act, 1974 , 1974

metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Balochistan (Amendment of Laws) Act, 1973 and the Balochistan Ordinance No. IV of 1974. name: The Balochistan Animal Slaughter Control Act, 2025 , 2026

metadata.title: The Balochistan Animal Slaughter Control Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the slaughter of useful animals and regulates the slaughter of other animals within Balochistan. It establishes definitions for various terms related to animal handling, slaughter methods, and veterinary oversight.

name: The Balochistan Arts Council Act, 2018 (Amendment-2021) , 2021

metadata.title: The Balochistan Arts Council Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Balochistan Arts Council to promote and develop art and craft within the province. It defines the Council's functions, which include organizing cultural events, providing art education, and managing an endowment fund.

name: The Balochistan Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowance) Act, 1975 , 1975

metadata.title: The Balochistan Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: Balochistan Act No. III of 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends and consolidates the law regarding salaries, allowances, and other facilities for members of the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan. It also provides specific privileges to the Leader of the Opposition within the Provincial Assembly.

name: The Balochistan Board of Revenue Act, 1957 , 1957

metadata.title: The Balochistan Board of Revenue Act, 1957
metadata.repeals: W.P. Ord. XII of 1956
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the constitution and powers of the Board of Revenue for Balochistan. It vests superintendence and control over revenue officers and courts in the Board while subjecting it to government direction, and designates the Board as the highest appellate authority in revenue cases.

name: The Balochistan Board of Technical and Vocational Education Act, 2021 , 2021

metadata.title: The Balochistan Board of Technical and Vocational Education Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Balochistan Board of Technical and Vocational Education as an independent body to conduct examinations and assessments for technical and vocational qualifications in the province. name: The Balochistan Charge Nurses Compulsory Service Act, 1975 , 1975

metadata.summary: This Act was enacted to secure the services of Charge Nurses for the Province of Balochistan. It mandates that qualified Charge Nurses serve the province for a minimum of three years if required by the Government, with specific timelines based on when they qualified.

name: The Balochistan Child Marriages Restraint Act, 2025 , 2025

metadata.title: The Balochistan Child Marriages Restraint Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act aims to restrain the solemnization of child marriages and related matters within Balochistan. It establishes severe punishments for adults who contract or solemnize such marriages, mandates the use of computerized National Identity cards for registration, and declares child marriages void ab initio under specific circumstances.

name: The Balochistan Child Protection, Act, 2016 , 2016

metadata.title: The Balochistan Child Protection Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Child Protection Commission within the Social Welfare Department to provide policy guidelines and strategies for protecting children in Balochistan. name: The Balochistan Civil Servant (Amendment) Act, 2015 , 2015

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Balochistan Civil Servants Act, 1974 to facilitate the absorption of federal civil servants transferred to Balochistan following the devolution of functions under the Eighteenth Amendment. name: The Balochistan Civil servent Act 1974 , 1974

name: The Balochistan Coastal Development Authority Act, 1998 , 1998

name: The Balochistan Commission on the Status of Women Act, 2017 , 2017

name: The Balochistan Commission on the Status of Women Act, 2017 , 2017

name: The Balochistan Companies Profits (Workers Participation Act, 2022 (Amendment-2026) , 2026

name: The Balochistan Development Authority Act, 1974 , 1974

name: The Balochistan Finance Act 1975 , 1975

name: The Balochistan Finance Act, 1964 , 1964

metadata.title: The Balochistan Finance Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act continues and revises certain taxes and fees while enacting the law of public finance management for the Province of Balochistan. name: The Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act, 2016 (Amendment-2025) , 2016

name: The West Pakistan Mineral Development Corporation Act, 1958 , 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Mineral Development Corporation Act, 1958

name: The West Pakistan Publication of Books Regulation and Control Ord, 1969 , 1969

name: The West Pakistan Publication of Text books regulation and control ordinance 1970 , 1970

name: The west pakistan shops and establishments ordinance, 1969 , 1969

name: Travel Agencies Act, 2014 , 2014

name: Turist Guide Act 2014 , 2014

name: West Pakistan Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963 , 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963

name: Baln Regulation I of 1984 , 1984

metadata.summary: This Regulation applies specific laws in force in Balochistan to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas. It causes certain existing local laws, instruments, customs, or usages with the force of law to cease operating upon its commencement.

name: Balochistan Emergency Adminstration Regulation 1935 , 1935

It establishes severe punishments including death or transportation for fanatics committing murder and outlines procedures for property forfeiture and body disposal.
