It amends several existing acts, including the Court Fees Act of 1870 and the West Pakistan Family Courts Act of 1964, to update fee structures and procedures.

name: Baln Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001 (Ord. I of 2001) , 2001

metadata.title: The Balochistan Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.amends: The Balochistan Finance Act, 1996
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Balochistan Finance Act, 1996 by omitting specific sections (3, 4, 7, 8, 11, and 12). It was promulgated by the Governor of Balochistan on February 2, 2001, following the suspension of the Provincial Assembly.

name: Baln Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001 (Ord. XXXIV of 2001) , 2001

metadata.title: The Balochistan Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.amends: The Balochistan Finance Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends section 5 of the Balochistan Finance Act, 1965 to update the table of tax rates on cinemas. It establishes specific annual tax amounts for Class-I, Class-II, and Class-III cinemas.

name: Baln Govt Lands and Buildings Recovery of Possession Ordinance, 1966 , 1966

metadata.title: The Balochistan Government Lands and Buildings (Recovery of Possession) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the speedy recovery of possession of Government lands and buildings from outgoing lessees, licensees, and unauthorised occupants. It empowers authorised officers to enter premises, evict occupants, demolish structures, and recover costs or rent arrears when leases expire or are revoked.

name: Baln Ombudsman Ordinance 2001 , 2001

metadata.title: The Establishment of the Office of Ombudsman for the Province of Balochistan Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the office of the Provincial Ombudsman for Balochistan to diagnose, investigate, and redress injustices caused by mal-administration. It defines the qualifications, tenure, powers, and functions of the Ombudsman and their staff while outlining procedures for handling complaints against public servants.

name: Baln Ordianace X of 1981 , 1981

metadata.title: The Balochistan Education Project (Implementation and Regulation) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the planning, construction, and procurement of facilities for educational institutions in Balochistan. It establishes a Project Committee to supervise implementation and authorizes the government to appoint officers and make rules regarding employment terms and financial procedures.

name: Baln Ordiance XI of 1981 , 1981

metadata.title: The Land Reforms (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.amends: The Land Reforms Regulation, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Land Reforms Regulation, 1972 by modifying specific paragraphs regarding tenant definitions and holding partitions. It was promulgated by the Governor of Balochistan with the President's sanction to address immediate circumstances.

name: Baln ordinance I of 1981 , 1981

metadata.title: The Insolvency (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.amends: The Insolvency Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Insolvency Act, 1920 to add a proviso regarding the exercise of powers in specific districts. It stipulates that in Kalat and Khuzdar Civil Districts, the powers of the District Court shall be exercised by Presidents of the respective Majlis-e-Shooras.

name: Baln Ordinance III of 1984 , 1984

metadata.title: The Court Fees (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Court Fees Act, 1870
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Court Fees Act, 1870 as it applies to the Province of Balochistan. It omits specific sections and articles from the said Act and substitutes new clauses in Schedule-II regarding fee amounts for probate and succession certificates.

name: Baln Ordinance VI of 1981 , 1981

metadata.title: The Balochistan Literacy and Mass-Education Council Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Balochistan Literacy and Mass-Education Council as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the council's composition, including ex-officio members and nominated representatives from non-government organizations and religious scholars, to promote literacy in the province.

name: Baln Ordinance VII of 1981 , 1981

metadata.title: The Land Reforms (Balochistan Pat Feeder Canal) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.amends: The Land Reforms (Balochistan Pat Feeder Canal) Regulation, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Land Reforms (Balochistan Pat Feeder Canal) Regulation, 1972 by renumbering paragraphs, substituting references to the Federal Government with the Provincial Government, and adding new powers for the Provincial Government. It also establishes procedures for calling records of cases and passing orders while ensuring affected persons have an opportunity to be heard.

name: Baln Ordinance, V of 1982 , 1982

metadata.title: The Balochistan Local Councils (Validation of Tax) Ordinance, 1982
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates certain taxes, rates, tolls, or fees levied under the Balochistan Local Government Ordinance, 1980. It deems such levies valid even if they were not paid before the Ordinance came into force, allowing for their recovery thereafter.

name: Baln Ordninace Xiv 1983 , 1983

metadata.title: The Stamp (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.amends: The Stamp Act, 1899
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Stamp Act, 1899 to apply specifically to the Province of Balochistan. It inserts a new item (27-A) into Schedule I regarding participation term certificates, levying the same duty as on debentures.

name: Balochistan Civil Courts Ordinance 1962 , 1962

metadata.title: The Balochistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to Civil Courts in the Province of Balochistan. It establishes classes of civil courts, defines their jurisdiction, and outlines provisions regarding appointments and powers of judicial officers.

name: Balochistan District Reconstitution Ordinance 1960 , 1960

metadata.title: The Balochistan Districts (Reconstitution) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the alteration of district limits and the constitution of new districts in Balochistan. It grants the Government power to alter these limits via notification and outlines how existing laws apply to areas affected by these changes.

name: Balochistan Institute of Information Technology and Mangement Sciences Ordinance, 2002 , 2002

metadata.title: The Balochistan Institute of Information Technology and Management Sciences Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Balochistan Institute of Information Technology and Management Sciences at Loralai to provide quality education and training in computer and information technology. It defines the institute as a body corporate with powers to admit students, prescribe courses, conduct research, and appoint staff.

name: Balochistan Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance 1960 , 1960

metadata.title: The Balochistan Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to preventive detention and the control of persons and publications in Balochistan. It grants powers to arrest, detain, and control suspected persons acting prejudicial to public safety or order, as well as powers to control publications and secure reports of public meetings.

name: Balochistan Prisoners amendment Ordinance 2001 , 2001

metadata.title: The Balochistan Prisoners (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.amends: The Balochistan Prisoners Act, 1900
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Balochistan Prisoners Act, 1900 by substituting specific judicial titles throughout the text. It replaces references to Presidency Magistrates, District Magistrates, and Sub-Divisional Magistrates with Session Judges or District and Session Judges as appropriate.

name: Balochistan Prohibition of Opium Smoking Ordinance 1960 , 1960

metadata.title: The Balochistan Prohibition of Opium Smoking Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law regarding the prohibition of opium smoking in the Province of Balochistan. It defines key terms, prohibits the manufacture, possession, or use of opium and related apparatus, and outlines penalties for various offences including failing to give notice of opium smoking locations.

name: Balochistan Suppresssion of Prostitution Ordinance 1961 , 1961

metadata.title: The Balochistan Suppression of Prostitution Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to amend and consolidate the law relating to the suppression of prostitution in the Province of Balochistan. It defines key terms such as brothel, prostitution, and public place, and establishes punishments for offenses including keeping a brothel, soliciting, and living on the earnings of prostitution.

name: Balochistan Tax on Land Agricultural Incone Ordinance, 2000 , 2000

metadata.title: The Balochistan Tax on Land and Agricultural Income Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the imposition of tax on land and income derived from agricultural land situated in the Province of Balochistan. It was promulgated by the Governor of Balochistan on June 30, 2000, following the suspension of the Provincial Assembly due to a state of emergency.

name: Code of Criminal Procedure Balochistan Amendment Ordinance 2001 , 2001

metadata.title: The Code of Criminal Procedure (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.amends: The Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 by substituting references to police officers with District Administrative Officers or Assistant District Administrative Officers in specific sections. It was promulgated by the Governor of Balochistan on October 6, 2001, and extends only to 'B' areas of Balochistan.

name: Conciliation Courts West Pak Amendment Ordinance, 1966 , 1966

metadata.title: The Conciliation Courts (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.amends: Conciliation Courts Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Conciliation Courts Ordinance, 1961 specifically for its application to the Province of West Pakistan. It was promulgated by the Governor because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate legislation was deemed necessary.

name: EX-EMPLOYEES OF THE FORMER GOV OF EAST PAKISTAN (APPOINTMENT TO PROVINCIAL POSTS) ORDI,1983 , 1983

metadata.title: The Ex-Employees of the Former Government of East Pakistan (Appointment to Provincial Posts) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the appointment of former employees of the Government of East Pakistan to posts under the Provincial Government of Balochistan. It stipulates that service rendered under the former government counts towards seniority and pension eligibility in the new provincial roles.

name: Gwadar Application of Balochistan laws Ordinance 1962 , 1962

metadata.title: The Gwadar (Application of Balochistan Laws) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.repeals: Gwadar law
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends all Balochistan Acts, Orders, and other enactments in force in the Mekran District to the territory of Gwadar. It deems these laws to have been in force in Gwadar since September 8, 1958, while preserving rights and liabilities accrued under previous local laws prior to the Ordinance's commencement.

name: Prevention of Corruption West Pakistan Amendment Ordinance 1960 , 1960

metadata.title: The Prevention of Corruption (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.amends: The Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947 to apply specifically to the Province of West Pakistan. It introduces new sections requiring public servants to declare assets disproportionate to their known income and prescribing penalties for failing to do so or possessing property acquired by improper means.

name: Prisons Balochistan Amendment Ordinance 2001 , 2001

metadata.title: The Prisons (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.amends: The Prisons Act, 1894
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Prisons Act, 1894 by substituting the term 'Magistrate' for 'District Magistrate' in specific sections. It was promulgated by the Governor of Balochistan to take immediate action under the Provisional Constitution.

name: Provincial Small Cause Courts West Pak Amendment Ordinance, 1966 , 1966

metadata.title: The Provincial Small Cause Courts (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.amends: The Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1887 specifically for its application to the Province of West Pakistan. It substitutes specific monetary figures and references regarding court jurisdiction within sections 15 and 27-A of the said Act.

name: Road Transport corporation Balochistan Removal of Undesirable Employees Ordinance, 1965 , 1965

metadata.title: The Road Transport Corporation (Balochistan) Removal of Undesirable Employees Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the termination of services of undesirable employees of the Road Transport Corporation. It establishes procedures for determining undesirability, granting appeals to the Government, and protecting officials acting in good faith under the law.

name: Sind Co-operative Societites West Pakistan Amendment ordinance 1965 , 1965

metadata.title: The Sind Co-operative Societies (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.amends: The Sind Co-operative Societies Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the Sind Co-operative Societies Act, 1925 by substituting references to 'Sind' with 'the Province of West Pakistan' and making various other textual changes. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: The Baln Acquisition of Property Residence of Govt officials Ordinance 1963 , 1963

metadata.title: The Balochistan Acquisition of Property (Residence of Government Officials) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the acquisition of specific property in Mauza Mian Mir, District Lahore, to be used as a residence for Government officials. It also validates actions taken under Martial Law Order No. 115 issued on February 24, 1962, and mandates compensation of ninety-six thousand rupees to the original occupants.

name: The Baln Acquisition of Property Wapda House Ordinane 1963 , 1963

metadata.title: The Balochistan Acquisition of Property (WAPDA House) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the acquisition of specific evacuee property in Lahore to construct an office for the Water and Power Development Authority. It also validates actions taken under Martial Law Order No. 129 issued on May 29, 1962, which were previously questioned regarding their validity.

name: The Baln Autonomous Bodies Immovable Property (Ejectment of Unauthorized Occupancys)Ord,1965 , 1965

metadata.title: The Balochistan Autonomous Bodies Immovable Property (Ejectment of Unauthorized Occupants) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the summary ejectment of unauthorized occupants from immovable property vested in autonomous bodies. It defines 'autonomous body' and 'Government', outlines the process for eviction notices, and establishes procedures for appeals against eviction orders.

name: The Baln Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1977 , 1977

metadata.title: The Balochistan Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education in Balochistan at Quetta. It defines the Board's powers, jurisdiction, structure, and the roles of its officers and committees.

name: The Baln Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1977 , 1977

metadata.title: The Balochistan Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education in Balochistan at Quetta. It defines the Board's powers, jurisdiction, structure, and the roles of its officers and committees.

name: The Baln Co-Operative Societies & Co-Operative Bankds Re-payment of Loans Ord, 1966 , 1966

metadata.title: The Balochistan Co-operative Societies and Co-operative Banks (Repayment of Loans) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the securing and repayment of unsecured or insufficiently secured loans taken from co-operative societies and banks. It establishes definitions for key terms, outlines procedures for loan recovery, and grants specific powers to the Registrar regarding inquiries and penalties.

name: The Baln Finance (Amend) Ordinance, 2001 , 2001

metadata.title: The Balochistan Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.amends: The Balochistan Finance Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Balochistan Finance Ordinance, 1969 by reducing a specific fee from twenty-five paisa to thirteen paisa per ticket. It was promulgated by the Governor of Balochistan on October 20, 2001, and came into force immediately.

name: The Baln Finance Act (Amend) Ordinance, 1985 , 1985

metadata.title: The Balochistan Finance Act (Amendment) Ordinance, 1985
metadata.amends: The Balochistan Finance Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends section 16 of the Balochistan Finance Act, 1963 to provide exemptions on taxes for profits arising from the assignment or sale of immovable property financed by banking companies. It also clarifies that these exemptions do not apply in cases of forced sales due to customer default.

name: The Baln Finance Ordinance, 1984 , 1984

metadata.title: The Balochistan Finance Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Balochistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance rationalizes and enhances certain rates of taxes in the Province of Balochistan. It amends the Balochistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958 by substituting its Schedule with a new one containing updated tax rates for various vehicle categories.

name: The Baln Governament Dues Recovery Ordinance, 1962 , 1968

metadata.title: The Balochistan Government Dues Recovery Ordinance, 1962 (Extension to Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1968
metadata.amends: The Balochistan Government Dues Recovery Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Regulation extends the Balochistan Government Dues Recovery Ordinance, 1962, to the Tribal Areas of Balochistan. It also applies specific provisions of the Revenue Recovery Act, 1890, to these areas for the purposes of the said Ordinance.

name: The Baln Hill Tract Ordinance, 1989 , 1989

metadata.title: The Balochistan Hill Tract Improvement Ordinance (Repeal) Act, 1989
metadata.repeals: The Balochistan Hill Tract Improvement Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Balochistan Hill Tract Improvement Ordinance, 1961. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan and assented to by the Governor on November 28, 1989.

name: The Baln Horse Race Betting Tax (Repeal) Ordinance, 1985 , 1985

metadata.title: The Balochistan Horse Race Betting Tax (Repeal) Ordinance, 1985
metadata.repeals: The Balochistan Horse Race Betting Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of Balochistan to repeal the Balochistan Horse Race Betting Tax Act, 1958. The legislation was enacted due to a complete ban on horse race betting and circumstances requiring immediate action under Article 128 of the Constitution.

name: The Baln Levies Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1980 , 1980

metadata.title: The Balochistan Levies Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Balochistan Levies Welfare Fund to provide relief and welfare for levymen and their families in Balochistan. It outlines the fund's composition, utilization for specific purposes like scholarships and burial expenses, and sets up Provincial and District Managing Committees to administer the fund.

name: The Baln Model Residential Secondary Schools Ordinance XVII of 1983 , 1983

metadata.title: The Balochistan Model Residential Secondary Schools Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of Model Residential Secondary Schools in Balochistan to promote education. It establishes a Board of Governors for each school, defines their composition and powers, and outlines regulations regarding property, funds, and staff appointments.

name: The Baln Private Security Companies Ordinance, 2001 , 2001

metadata.title: The Balochistan Private Security Companies Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation, licensing, and control of private security companies in the Province of Balochistan. It establishes procedures for granting licenses, defines prohibited activities such as wearing military-style uniforms or possessing arms without authorization, and outlines penalties for non-compliance.

name: The Baln Qaumi Razakars Ordinance, 1965 , 1965

metadata.title: The Balochistan Qaumi Razakars Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law relating to Qaumi Razakars in the Province of Balochistan. It establishes their constitution, duties, powers, and legal protections while defining the authority of the Deputy Commissioner over them.

name: The Baln Seeds and Fruit Plants Ordinance 1965.doc , 1965

metadata.title: The Balochistan Seeds and Fruit Plants Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the better production and distribution of high-quality seeds and fruit plants in the Province of Balochistan. It establishes a framework for registering growers, certifying seeds and plants, and regulating their sale and distribution.

name: The Baln Text Book Board Ordinance, 1977 , 1977

metadata.title: The Balochistan Text Book Board Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Balochistan Text Book Board to prepare, produce, and publish textbooks for classes I to XII. It defines the Board's corporate status, constitution, and the powers of its controlling authority.

name: The Baln Tribunals of Inquiry Ordinance, 1969 , 1969

metadata.title: The Balochistan Tribunals of Inquiry Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the appointment of Tribunals, Commissions, or Committees of Inquiry to investigate matters of public importance. It vests these bodies with specific powers similar to civil courts and grants additional authorities for information gathering and document seizure.

name: The Baln. Marble & Coal Minerals Control of Movement Ordinance ,1978 , 1978

metadata.title: The Balochistan Marble and Coal Minerals (Control of Movement) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the control of the movement of Marble and Coal Minerals from Balochistan to other provinces. It establishes a Licensing Authority to issue permits (rahdari) required for transporting these minerals by road or rail.

name: The Balochistan Acquisition of Property Wapda office Second ordinance. , 1963

metadata.title: The Balochistan Acquisition of Property (WAPDA Office) (Second) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the acquisition of specific evacuee properties in Mozang, Lahore, to construct an office for the Water and Power Development Authority. It also validates actions previously taken under Martial Law Orders Nos. 92 and 109 regarding these properties.

name: The Balochistan Agricultural Pests ordinance 1959.doc , 1959

metadata.title: The Balochistan Agricultural Pests Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law regarding the eradication of agricultural pests in the Province of Balochistan. It establishes the powers of the Government to prohibit cultivation methods or crop transport, defines the duties of occupiers to carry out preventive measures, and grants inspectors authority to inspect land, seize infested crops, and recover expenses.

name: The Balochistan Board of intermedaite and Secondary Education Quetta ordinance,1969 , 1969

metadata.title: The Balochistan Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Quetta) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education at Quetta as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the Board's jurisdiction over institutions in the Divisions of Quetta and Kalat, transferring powers previously held by the Multan Board.

name: The Balochistan Buildings Control Ordinance, 1979 , 1979

metadata.title: The Balochistan Buildings Control Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the planning, construction, control, and demolition of buildings within the Province of Balochistan. It also governs the disposal of buildings and plots by builders and societies.

name: The Balochistan Consolidation of Holding Ordinance 1960 , 1960

metadata.title: The Balochistan Consolidation of Holdings Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to the consolidation of holdings in the Province of Balochistan. It establishes procedures for applications, schemes, compensation, and the transfer of rights regarding land estates.

name: The Balochistan Control of Goondas Ordinance 1959 , 1959

metadata.title: The Balochistan Control of Goondas Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to the control of disorderly persons commonly known as goondas in the Province of Balochistan. It establishes Tribunals with specific powers to conduct inquiries, summon witnesses, and issue orders against declared goondas within the province.

name: The Balochistan corporation Employees special powers ordinance, 1978 , 1978

metadata.title: The Balochistan Corporation Employees (Special Powers) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance invests the Governor of Balochistan with special powers to remove or revert persons in Corporation service without notice. It applies to individuals appointed or promoted between January 1, 1972, and July 5, 1977, who are employed by corporations established or controlled by the Government of Balochistan.

name: The Balochistan Duty on Excessive wastage of spirits in Distilleries Validation Ordinance,1969 , 1969

metadata.title: The Balochistan Duty on Excessive Wastage of Spirits in Distilleries (Validation) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the levy and recovery of excise duty on excessive wastage of spirits in distilleries occurring from July 1, 1940 onwards. It deems any duty collected prior to this Ordinance that aligns with these provisions as validly levied and recoverable under the Punjab Excise Act, 1914.

name: The Balochistan Finance Ordinance, 1980 , 1980

metadata.title: The Balochistan Finance Ordinance, 1980
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance levies and collects a toll tax on light and heavy vehicles passing through the Hub River Bridge in the Province of Balochistan. It specifies exemptions for government vehicles and those registered in Lasbela District, outlines penalties for non-compliance, and amends Section 4(1) of the West Pakistan Finance Act, 1963 to apply these provisions to Balochistan.

name: The Balochistan Finance Ordinance 1970 , 1970

metadata.title: The Balochistan Finance Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues and levies certain taxes, cesses, and surcharges in the newly formed Province of Balochistan. It establishes specific rates for cinema tax, motor vehicle surcharges, and railway freight and fare taxes for the financial year 1970-71.

name: The Balochistan Finance ordinance 1971 , 1971

metadata.title: The Balochistan Finance Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues and levies certain taxes, cesses, and surcharges in the Province of Balochistan for the financial year 1971-72. It specifically establishes rates for cinema tax based on class and imposes a surcharge on motor vehicle taxes.

name: The Balochistan Finance Ordinance, 1969 , 1969

metadata.title: The Balochistan Finance Ordinance, 1969
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; W.P. Act XXIX of 1964; W.P. Act X of 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues and levies various taxes, cesses, and surcharges in the Province of Balochistan. It establishes specific rates for agricultural income-tax surcharges, cinema tax, motor vehicle tax, railway fare tax, enhanced electricity duty, and a welfare cess on admission tickets.

name: The Balochistan Goats Restriction Ordinance, 1959 , 1959

metadata.title: The Balochistan Goats (Restriction) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to restrict the number of goats in the Province of Balochistan for public interest. It grants the Government powers to regulate grazing, movement, and slaughter of goats, while establishing penalties for contravention and procedures for arrest and summary trial.

name: The Balochistan Governament Employees Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1969 , 1969

metadata.title: The Balochistan Government Employees Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Welfare Fund to provide relief and security for the employees of the Balochistan Government and their families. It creates separate funds for gazetted and non-gazetted servants, outlines contribution mechanisms, and sets up Provincial and Divisional Welfare Boards to administer the fund and arrange insurance coverage.

name: The Balochistan Government Dues Recovery Ordinance 1962 , 1962

metadata.title: The Balochistan Government Dues Recovery Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the recovery of Government dues as arrears of land revenue within the Province of Balochistan. It empowers the Government to issue notifications declaring specific dues recoverable under the Revenue Recoveries Act, 1890, and grants authority to make rules for implementing its provisions.

name: The Balochistan Government Educational and Training instructions Ordinance 1960 , 1960

metadata.title: The Balochistan Government Educational and Training Institutions Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Boards of Governors to manage and control Government educational and training institutions in Balochistan. It defines the constitution, powers, and functions of these boards, including their authority over property, staff recruitment, and financial management.

name: The Balochistan Government Servants Benevolent fund Ordinanace 1960 , 1960

metadata.title: The Balochistan Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Benevolent Fund to provide relief for Government servants and their families in Balochistan. The fund is financed through compulsory contributions from servants, government grants, donations, and investment income, and is utilized to offer financial assistance to deceased servants' families, invalided-out servants, and those in exceptional cases.

name: The Balochistan Government Servants Benevolent fund Ordinanace 1960 , 1960

metadata.title: The Balochistan Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Benevolent Fund to provide relief for Government servants and their families in Balochistan. The fund is financed through compulsory contributions from servants, government grants, donations, and investment income, and is utilized to offer financial assistance to deceased servants' families, invalided-out servants, and those in exceptional cases.

name: The Balochistan Highways Ordinance 1959.doc , 1959

metadata.title: The Balochistan Highways Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to highways in the Province of Balochistan. It establishes Highway Authorities, defines their powers regarding road construction and maintenance, regulates vehicle usage, and outlines penalties for offenses.

name: The Balochistan Hindu Women's Rights to Agricultrual Land Ordance, 1959 , 1959

metadata.title: The Balochistan Hindu Women's Rights to Agricultural Land Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: The North-West Frontier Province Hindu Women's Rights to Property (Extension to Agricultural Land) Act, 1942; The Hindu Women's Rights to Property (Sind Extension to Agricultural Land) Act, 1943
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the Hindu Law governing women's rights to agricultural land in the Province of Balochistan. It establishes specific rules for the devolution of such land when a Hindu dies intestate, granting widows shares equivalent to sons under certain conditions.

name: The Balochistan Hindu Women's Rights to Agricultrual Land Ordance, 1959. , 1959

metadata.title: The Balochistan Hindu Women's Rights to Agricultural Land Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: The North-West Frontier Province Hindu Women's Rights to Property (Extension to Agricultural Land) Act, 1942; The Hindu Women's Rights to Property (Sind Extension to Agricultural Land) Act, 1943
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the Hindu Law governing women's rights to agricultural land in the Province of Balochistan. It establishes specific rules for the devolution of such land when a Hindu dies intestate, granting widows shares equivalent to sons under certain conditions.

name: The Balochistan Historical Mosques and Shrines fund cess ordinance 1960 , 1960

metadata.title: The Balochistan Historical Mosques and Shrines Fund Cess Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the raising of funds through a specific cess to support the repair, maintenance, and endowment of historically significant mosques and shrines in Balochistan. The collected funds are managed in a dedicated trust to cover operational expenses and conservation projects.

name: The Balochistan Industries Control On Establishment and Enalrgment Ordinace 1963 , 1963

metadata.title: The Balochistan Industries (Control on Establishment and Enlargement) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the organized and planned growth of industries in Balochistan. It establishes restrictions on the establishment or enlargement of industrial undertakings without prior written government permission.

name: The Balochistan Information Techonology Board Ordinance, 2001 , 2001

metadata.title: The Balochistan Information Technology Board Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Balochistan Information Technology Board as a body corporate within the Province of Balochistan. It outlines the Board's constitution, functions, powers, and administrative procedures including funding and employee management.

name: The Balochistan Land Dispositions Saving of Shamilat Ordinance 1959 , 1959

metadata.title: The Balochistan Land Dispositions (Saving of Shamilat) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Land Dispositions (Saving of Shamilat) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for a uniform interpretation of general expressions regarding the disposition of 'Shamilat' lands in the Province of Balochistan. It stipulates that such lands are not included in any land disposition unless specifically mentioned as the subject matter, regardless of whether the disposition is testamentary or otherwise.

name: The Balochistan Land Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001 , 2001

metadata.title: The Balochistan Land Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.amends: The Balochistan Land Laws
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends several existing land laws in Balochistan to substitute the term 'Commissioner' with 'Revenue Tribunal' and to define the Revenue Tribunal. It was promulgated by the Governor of Balochistan under the Provisional Constitution (Amendment) Order, 1999.

name: The Balochistan Land Reforms regulation Amendment ordinance 1970 , 1970

metadata.title: The Balochistan Land Reforms Regulation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.amends: The Balochistan Land Reforms Regulation
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends paragraph 5 of the Balochistan Land Reforms Regulation by replacing a full-stop with a colon and adding a further proviso. The added proviso ensures that orders passed by Land Commissioners or their deputies are subject to appeal, review, or revision in the same manner as other such orders.

name: The Balochistan Laws Adaptation Order, 1975 , 1975

metadata.title: The Balochistan Laws (Adaptation) Order, 1975
metadata.summary: This Order adapts existing laws made by the legislative authority in Balochistan to align with the Constitution of Pakistan, 1973. It authorizes the Governor to substitute terms like 'Central' with 'Federal' and 'West Pakistan' with 'Balochistan' across various statutes.

name: The Balochistan Local Councials High Schools (Taking Over Ordinance 1970 , 1970

metadata.title: The Balochistan Local Councils High Schools (Taking Over) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the taking over of High Schools maintained by District Councils and Town Committees in Balochistan by the Government. It transfers control, staff, assets, and funds from local bodies to the Government while allowing for exceptions and specific contributions towards pensions.

name: The Balochistan Milk Boards Ordinance, 1963 , 1963

metadata.title: The Balochistan Milk Boards Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the production and marketing of milk and milk products in Balochistan. It establishes a Milk Board as a body corporate with powers to acquire property, sue, and be sued.

name: The Balochistan Ministerial English Service Joint Cadre Dissolution Ordinance 1971 , 1971

metadata.title: The Balochistan Ministerial (English) Service Joint Cadre (Dissolution) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the dissolution of the Balochistan Ministerial (English) Service Joint Cadre and allocates its members to various departments of the Provincial Government. It deems the cadre dissolved as of September 30, 1965, and outlines rules regarding seniority and service allocation.

name: The Balochistan Orphanges ( Supervision and Control) Ordinance, 1987 , 1987

metadata.title: The Balochistan Orphanages (Supervision and Control) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Board to supervise and regulate the working and control of orphanages in Balochistan. It defines the composition, tenure, and functions of the Board, including provisions for licensing, medical examinations, and penalties.

name: The Balochistan Pat Feeder Area Settlement of Land Dispute Ordinance 1970 , 1970

metadata.title: The Balochistan Pat Feeder Area (Settlement of Land Disputes) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to safeguard the rights and interests of the Provincial Government and genuine owners of land in the Pat Feeder Area of Kachhi and Sibi Districts. It establishes a Tribunal to adjudicate claims regarding proprietary rights in areas where the government determined ownership rests with the state, while allowing genuine claimants to submit their cases before a specified deadline.

name: The Balochistan prevention of Gambling ordinance ,1978 , 1978

metadata.title: The Balochistan Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the prevention of gambling within the Province of Balochistan. It defines terms such as common gaming-house and gaming, while establishing penalties for owning, keeping, or participating in gambling activities.

name: The Balochistan Private Colleges Management and control ordinance 1970 , 1970

metadata.title: The Balochistan Private Colleges (Management and Control) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the control and management of private colleges in Balochistan. It establishes a Governing Body for each college to maximize academic efficiency, streamline administration, and regulate teacher service conditions.

name: The Balochistan privy purses charged expenditure ordinance,1969 , 1969

metadata.title: The Balochistan Privy Purses (Charged Expenditure) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance declares that the expenditure relating to the privy purses of Rulers of former States incorporated into Balochistan is a charge on the Provincial Consolidated Fund. It further stipulates that sums paid by the Federal Government as privy purses to such rulers or their successors shall be reimbursed from this fund.

name: The Balochistan Prohibition of Expressing Matters on Walls Ordinance, 2001 , 2001

metadata.title: The Balochistan Prohibition of Expressing Matters on Walls Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the expression of matters on walls within the Province of Balochistan, excluding Tribal Areas. It prescribes penalties including imprisonment and fines for violations while allowing exceptions for owners expressing details about themselves or their businesses.

name: The Balochistan Prohibition of Smoking in Cinema Houses Ordinance, 1960 , 1960

metadata.title: The Balochistan Prohibition of Smoking in Cinema Houses Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits smoking in cinema houses within the Province of Balochistan. It establishes penalties including fines and arrest without warrant for individuals caught smoking during performances or exhibitions.

name: The Balochistan Prohibition on use and Sale of Polythen Begs Ordinance, 2001.doc , 2001

metadata.title: The Balochistan Prohibition on Use and Sale of Polythene Bags Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the import, manufacture, sale, and use of polythene bags in the Province of Balochistan. It defines key terms such as 'Factory', 'Person', and 'Polythene bags' and establishes penalties for violations, including imprisonment or fines.

name: The Balochistan Provincial Council Ordinance, 1980 , 1980

metadata.title: Balochistan Provincial Council Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution of the Provincial Council for the Province of Balochistan. It defines the composition, term of office, and functions of the Council, as well as procedures for resignation, dissolution, and removal of members.

name: The Balochistan Recovery of Cost (Copies of Essential Revenue Records) Ordinance 1963 , 1963

metadata.title: The Balochistan Recovery of Cost (Copies of Essential Revenue Records) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the recovery of costs incurred by the Government in preparing and supplying copies of essential revenue records to Union Councils. It mandates that these records be made available to the public for inspection during office hours and establishes the mechanism for recovering these costs from land revenue payers.

name: The Balochistan Relief of Indebteness ordinance 1960 , 1960

metadata.title: The Balochistan Relief of Indebtedness Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the relief of indebtedness in the Province of Balochistan. It establishes powers for courts to limit recoverable interest, allows debtors to deposit money in court to stop interest accumulation, and provides exemptions from attachment or sale for specific assets like houses and milch animals.

name: The Balochistan Requisitioning of Stage Carriages Temporary Powers Ordinance, 1970 , 1970

metadata.title: The Balochistan Requisitioning of Stage Carriages (Temporary Powers) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the temporary requisitioning of stage carriages to ensure the maintenance of passenger transport services. It grants powers to District Magistrates to requisition vehicles, manage their use and repairs, and pay associated costs while offering compensation to owners.

name: The Balochistan Rice Restrictions on Cultivation Ordinance 1959 , 1959

metadata.title: The Balochistan Rice (Restrictions on Cultivation) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the cultivation of rice in the Province of Balochistan to check waterlogging, salinity, and seepage damage. It grants the Board of Revenue powers to impose restrictions on cultivation and provides for penalties for contravention.

name: The Balochistan sportsmens welfare fund ordinance, 1980.doc , 1980

metadata.title: The Balochistan Sportsmen's Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Sportsmen Welfare Fund specifically for the sportsmen of the Province of Balochistan. It creates a Provincial Fund and constitutes a Board to manage its operations, collection, and distribution of financial assistance, particularly for medical treatment in distress.

name: The Balochistan Students Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1979 , 1979

metadata.title: The Balochistan Students Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Students Welfare Fund specifically for the students of the Province of Balochistan. It creates a Provincial Board to manage the fund, which provides financial assistance to students in distress and encourages sports activities.

name: The Balochistan Survey and Rectangulation of Land Ordinance 1959 , 1959

metadata.title: The Balochistan Survey and Rectangulation of Lands Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the survey and rectangulation of lands in the Province of Balochistan. It empowers the Board of Revenue to direct these operations, assess their costs, and prescribe rules for their implementation.

name: The Balochistan system of sardari Abolition ordinance,1978 , 1978

metadata.title: The Balochistan System of Sardari (Abolition) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance abolishes the system of Sardari prevalent in certain parts of Balochistan, which is described as a remnant of an oppressive feudal and tribal system. It prohibits recognized Sardars from exercising unauthorized judicial powers, maintaining private jails, arresting persons without legal authority, taking free labor, or demanding tribute.

name: The Balochistan Tenancy Ordinance, 1978 , 1978

metadata.title: The Balochistan Tenancy Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the legal framework for tenancy rights, occupancy rights, and rent regulations in Balochistan. It defines various classes of tenants, outlines procedures for rent collection and alteration, and sets rules regarding ejectment, alienation, and compensation for improvements.

name: The Balochistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance 1962 , 1962

metadata.title: The Balochistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the levy of tolls on public roads and bridges in the Province of Balochistan. It grants the Government powers to set up toll gates, lease out toll collection rights, and impose penalties for non-payment or unlawful levies.

name: The Balochistan Undesirable Companies Ordinance, 1959 , 1959

metadata.title: The Balochistan Undesirable Companies Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the registration of companies carrying on business for certain undesirable purposes within Balochistan. It also provides legal mechanisms for the winding up and dissolution of such existing companies.

name: The Balochistan Undesirable Companies Ordinance, 1959 , 1959

metadata.title: The Balochistan Undesirable Companies Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the registration of companies carrying on business for certain undesirable purposes within Balochistan. It also provides legal mechanisms for the winding up and dissolution of such existing companies.

name: The Balochistan Universities Removal of Undesirable Government Servants Ordinance 1962 , 1962

metadata.title: The Balochistan Universities Removal of Undesirable Government Servants Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the termination of services of Government servants serving in universities and other educational institutions who are deemed undesirable. It empowers the Governor to terminate such services after giving the servant a reasonable opportunity to show cause against the proposed action.

name: The Balochistan University of Information Technology and management sceiences quetta Ordi 2002 , 2002

metadata.title: The Balochistan University of Information Technology, Engineering and Management Sciences Quetta Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of the Balochistan University of Information Technology, Engineering and Management Sciences Quetta. It outlines the powers, functions, and structure of the university's authorities, including the Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, Senate, and Syndicate.

name: The Balochistan urban immovable property validation of valuation list and tax ordinance 1969 , 1969

metadata.title: The Balochistan Urban Immovable Property (Validation of Valuation List and Tax) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the valuation list and property tax levied on buildings and land located in the Sind Industrial Trading Estate, Karachi. It deems the specified area to be a rating area from August 1963 and confirms the validity of taxes collected between January and July 1964.

name: The Balochistan Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance 1959 , 1959

metadata.title: The Balochistan Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to restrict the increase of rent and prevent the eviction of tenants in urban areas within Balochistan. It establishes a framework for determining fair rent, defining key terms like 'tenant' and 'landlord', and outlining penalties for violations.

name: The Balochistan Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance 1959 , 1959

metadata.title: The Balochistan Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to restrict the increase of rent and prevent the eviction of tenants in urban areas within Balochistan. It establishes a framework for determining fair rent, defining key terms like 'tenant' and 'landlord', and outlining penalties for violations.

name: The Balochistan Usurious Loans Ordinance 1959 , 1959

metadata.title: The Balochistan Usurious Loans Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law relating to usurious loans in the Province of Balochistan. It provides courts with powers to re-open transactions, relieve debtors from excessive interest liability, and revise unfair agreements or securities.

name: The Balochistan Waqf Properties Ordinance, 1979 , 1979

metadata.title: The Balochistan Waqf Properties Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the proper management and administration of waqf properties in the Province of Balochistan. It establishes the appointment of a Chief Administrator and outlines powers regarding property registration, eviction, leases, and financial management.

name: The Boiler West Pakistan Amendment Ordinance 1958 , 1958

metadata.title: The Boilers (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1958

metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Boilers Act, 1923 to extend its application to the Province of West Pakistan. It specifically updates definitions and powers related to Chief Inspectors, Additional Chief Inspectors, Deputy Chief Inspectors, and Inspectors within that province.

name: The Cooperative Societies (Baln Amend) Ordinance, 1985 , 1985

metadata.title: The Co-operative Societies (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1985
metadata.amends: The Co-operative Societies Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Co-operative Societies Act, 1925 specifically for its application to the Province of Balochistan. It introduces new clauses regarding the definition of loans and modifies various sections to include terms like 'return' alongside 'interest' and update references to banking instruments.

name: The Court Fees (Baln Amendment) Ordinance, 1980 (1) , 1980

metadata.title: The Court Fees (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.amends: The Court Fees Act, 1870
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Court Fees Act, 1870 specifically for its application to the Province of Balochistan. It omits Section 35-A and substitutes Schedule I with new fee entries subject to specific government notifications.

metadata.title: The Criminal Law (Special Provisions) (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1979

metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the Criminal Law (Special Provisions) Ordinance, 1968 specifically for its application to the Province of Balochistan. It adds specific wording regarding investigation powers held by the State Levies Force in relation to scheduled offences.

name: The Criminal Law Special Provision Baln Amendment Ordinance, 1980 , 1980

metadata.title: The Criminal Law (Special Provisions) (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.amends: The Criminal Law (Special Provisions) Ordinance, 1968
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Criminal Law (Special Provisions) Ordinance, 1968 specifically for its application to the Province of Balochistan. It authorizes the Deputy Commissioner or Political Agent to direct inquiries or investigations by other persons and grants them powers under the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898.

name: The criminal law west pakistan amendment ordinance ,1969 , 1969

metadata.title: The Criminal Law (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.amends: Pakistan Penal Code, 1860; Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Pakistan Penal Code, 1860, and the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 as they apply to West Pakistan. Specifically, it changes the maximum punishment for unlawful compulsory labour from one year to five years and alters arrest warrant requirements in Schedule II.

name: The Essential Personnel Registration West Pakistan Amendment Ordinance 1965 , 1965

metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Essential Personnel (Registration) Ordinance, 1948 specifically for its application to the Province of West Pakistan. It substitutes a new subsection in section 6 regarding the authority required to lodge complaints for court cognizance of offences.

name: The Expeditious Correction of Record of Rights in Baln. Ordinance 1977 , 1977

metadata.title: The Expeditious Correction of Record-of-Rights in Balochistan Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a simple and speedy procedure for correcting errors in the Record-of-Rights for specific areas of Balochistan. It was promulgated to address complaints regarding incorrect land entries and the excessive cost and length of existing correction procedures under previous Revenue Laws.

name: The Explosive Substances West Pakistan Amendment Ordinance 1970 , 1970

metadata.title: The Explosive Substances (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.amends: The Explosive Substances Act, 1908
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Explosive Substances Act, 1908, specifically regarding its application to the Province of West Pakistan. It inserts specific wording into section 7 of the 1908 Act to include authorization by a Provincial Government officer.

name: The Factories West Pakistan Amendment Ordinance, 1966 , 1966

metadata.title: The Factories (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.amends: The Factories Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Factories Act, 1934 as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. It substitutes specific words in existing sections and inserts a new section regarding overtime work for adult workers.

name: The Industrial Disputes (W. P Amendment) Ordinance, 1967 , 1967

metadata.title: The Industrial Disputes (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1967
metadata.amends: The Industrial Disputes Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Industrial Disputes Ordinance, 1959 specifically for its application to the Province of West Pakistan. It substitutes the word 'employees' in section 5, sub-section (6) of the 1959 Ordinance, with effect from November 5, 1966.

name: The Industrial Statistics West Pakistan Amendment Ordinance 1958 , 1958

metadata.title: The Industrial Statistics (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.amends: The Industrial Statistics Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Industrial Statistics Act, 1942 to apply it to the Province of West Pakistan. It inserts a new section allowing the statistics authority to delegate its powers and functions to subordinate officers with Provincial Government approval.

name: The Iqra University Quetta Ordinance 2002 , 2002

metadata.title: The Iqra University Quetta Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Iqra University Quetta as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Chancellor, President, and various authorities like the Board of Governors and Academic Council.

name: The Land Acquisition (Baln Amend) Ordinance, 2000 , 2000

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.amends: The Land Acquisition Act, 1894
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 specifically for its application to the Province of Balochistan. name: The Land Acquisition (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance 2000 , 2000

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.amends: The Land Acquisition Act, 1894
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 specifically for its application to the Province of Balochistan. It was promulgated by the Governor of Balochistan under emergency provisions because the Provincial Assembly was suspended.

name: The Land Acquisition (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance 1965 , 1965

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1965

metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 specifically for its application to the Province of Balochistan. name: The Land Acquisition Balochistan Amendment Ordinance ,1969 , 1969

metadata.amends: The Land Acquisition Act, 1894
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 specifically for its application to the Province of Balochistan. It repeals several previous enactments related to land acquisition in various regions and substitutes or amends specific sections regarding court definitions, public notices, and officer powers.

name: The Land Reforms (Balochistan Pat Feeder Canal Second Amendment Ordinance,1977 , 1977

metadata.title: The Land Reforms (Balochistan Pat Feeder Canal) (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.amends: The Land Reforms (Balochistan Pat Feeder Canal) Regulation, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the Land Reforms (Balochistan Pat Feeder Canal) Regulation, 1972 by omitting specific sub-paragraphs and inserting new provisions regarding the disposal of state land for public purposes. It also modifies existing paragraphs to adjust land grant limits, earmark areas for specific groups including military families, and establish procedures for cash compensation when land is unavailable.

name: The Land Reforms (Balochistan Pat Feeder Canal Second Amendment Ordinance,1977 , 1977

metadata.title: The Land Reforms (Balochistan Pat Feeder Canal) (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.amends: The Land Reforms (Balochistan Pat Feeder Canal) Regulation, 1972

It also modifies existing paragraphs to adjust land grant limits, earmark areas for specific groups including military families, and establish procedures for cash compensation when land is unavailable.

name: The Lasbela Industrial Estates Development Authority Ordinance of 1984 , 1984

metadata.title: The Lasbela Industrial Estates Development Authority Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Lasbela Industrial Estates Development Authority to promote and develop industrial estates in District Lasbela, Balochistan. It defines the Authority as a body corporate with perpetual succession, outlines its management structure including a Board of Directors, and grants powers for property acquisition and administration.

name: The Notaries West Pakistan Amendment Ordinance, 1966 , 1966

metadata.title: The Notaries (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.amends: The Notaries Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Notaries Ordinance, 1961, specifically regarding its application to the Province of West Pakistan. It substitutes a clause in section 8 to define the powers of administering oaths or taking affidavits.

name: The Notaries west pakistan amendment ordinance,1969 , 1969

metadata.title: The Notaries (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.amends: The Notaries Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the Notaries Ordinance, 1961 by adding a new section regarding the delegation of powers. It allows the Provincial Government to direct that certain powers be exercisable by subordinate officers or authorities under specified conditions.

name: The Pakistan Arms Ordinance, 1965 , 1965

metadata.title: The Pakistan Arms Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to the sale, transport, bearing, or possession of arms, ammunition, and military stores. It establishes prohibitions on unlicensed activities, defines various types of arms and ammunition, and outlines penalties for breaches of these regulations.

name: The Pakistan Criminal Law (West Pakistan Amendment Ordinance 1970 , 1970

metadata.title: The Pakistan Criminal Law (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.amends: The Pakistan Criminal Law Amendment Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Pakistan Criminal Law Amendment Act, 1958 to apply specific provisions to persons serving in connection with West Pakistan affairs. The amendment inserts words regarding the withdrawal of prosecution into section 12 of the existing Act.

name: The Prevention of Corruption Act West Pakistan Extension Ordinance 1958 , 1958

metadata.amends: The Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947
metadata.repeals: The Bahawalpur Prevention of Corruption Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947 to cover the entire Province of Balochistan. It also amends the said Act to reference local penal and criminal procedure codes for specific districts and repeals the Bahawalpur Prevention of Corruption Act, 1950.

name: The Prevention of Corruption West Pakistan Amendment Ordinance 1970 , 1970

metadata.title: The Prevention of Corruption (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.amends: The Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947 to apply it to persons in the Civil Services of West Pakistan or holding civil posts connected with the Province. Specifically, it substitutes the word 'Inspector' for 'Deputy Superintendent' and omits a specific proviso within section 5-A of the amended Act.

name: The Prisoners (Baln Amend) Ordinance, 1985 , 1985

metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Prisoners Act, 1900 specifically for its application to the Province of Balochistan. It deletes specific words and commas from section 40 of the said Act.

name: The Provincial Insolvency (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance 1959 , 1959

metadata.amends: The Provincial Insolvency Act, 1920

metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates various amendments to the Provincial Insolvency Act, 1920, specifically for the Province of West Pakistan. It adds a new sub-section regarding the temporary alienation of land belonging to an insolvent estate and repeals specific earlier enactments related to insolvency in Punjab and Sind.

name: The Provisional law officers ordinance, 2001 , 2001

metadata.title: The Provincial Law Officers Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the appointment of Provincial Law Officers, specifically the Additional and Assistant Advocate General, in Balochistan. It grants these officers the right of audience in all courts within Pakistan and establishes their qualifications and conditions of service.

name: The Quetta Development Authority Ordinance, 1978.doc , 1978

metadata.title: The Quetta Development Authority Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Quetta Development Authority and defines its constitution, functions, and powers regarding urban development. It outlines procedures for framing improvement and housing schemes, building regulations, land acquisition processes, and the assessment of betterment fees.

name: The Reformatory School (Baln Amend) Ordinance, 1985 , 1985

name: The Reformatory Schools (Baln Amend) Ordinance, 2001 , 2001

name: The Requistioning of Immovable Property for Defence Purpose Ordinance, 1980 , 1980

metadata.title: The Requisitioning of Immovable Property for Defence Purpose Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the requisitioning and retention of immovable property within Balochistan for the purpose of the defence of Pakistan. name: The Sind Race Courses Licensing (W. P. Amendment) Ordinance, 1969 , 1969

name: The Societies Registration West Pakistan Amendment Ordinance,1962 , 1962

metadata.title: The Societies Registration (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1962

metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Societies Registration Act, 1860 as it applies to West Pakistan. It inserts a new section allowing the provincial government to dissolve and reconstitute the governing bodies of registered societies under specific conditions.

name: The Stamp Balochistan Amendment Ordinance 1959 , 1959

metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the Stamp Act, 1899 specifically for its application to the Province of Balochistan. name: The Stamp Balochistan Amendment Ordinance 2002 , 2002

metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends Schedule I of the Stamp Act, 1899 to update stamp duty rates for articles and memorandums of association. name: The Stamps (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance, 2001 , 2001

metadata.title: The Stamps (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.amends: The Stamp Act, 1899
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the application of the Stamp Act, 1899 to the Province of Balochistan. It introduces new provisions for valuing urban land and substituting specific articles in the Act's Schedule I regarding conveyance and exchange of property duties.

name: The Succession (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1965 , 1965

metadata.title: The Succession (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.amends: The Succession Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Succession Act, 1925 as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. Specifically, it substitutes section 379 to require District Judges to calculate and collect court-fees before granting or extending certificates.

name: The Succession Balochistan Amendment Ordinance 1978 , 1978

metadata.title: The Succession (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.amends: The Succession Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Succession Act, 1925 to apply specifically to the Province of Balochistan. It adds specific text to Section 2 of the Act to include the Presidents of Majlis-e-Shoora in Kalat and Khuzdar Civil Districts within its jurisdiction.

name: The W. P. Railway Servants Benovelent Fund Ordinance,1969 , 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Railway Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Benevolent Fund to provide relief for Railway servants and their families in West Pakistan. The fund is financed through compulsory contributions, government grants, donations, and investment income, and is utilized to offer financial assistance to families of deceased or invalided servants.

name: The West Pakistan Abolition of Cess (Habubus) Ordinance, 1962 , 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Abolition of Cesses (Habubs) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.repeals: W.P. Act XVII of 1967
metadata.summary: This Ordinance abolishes all cesses (Habubs) leviable in cash or in kind within the Kalat Division, regardless of any existing agreements, usage, or custom. It clarifies that this abolition does not prevent landlords from recovering standard rent for land use and imposes penalties on individuals who continue to levy these abolished cesses.

name: The West Pakistan Agricultrul Bank (Recovery of Dues) Ordinance 1959 , 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agricultural Bank (Recovery of Dues) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides facilities to the Agricultural Bank for recovering its dues. It allows agriculturists and cooperative societies to pledge, mortgage, hypothecate, or assign movable or immovable property to the Bank to secure loans.

name: The West Pakistan Industirial Ordinance ,1968 , 1968

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Industrial and Commercial Employment (Standing Orders) Ordinance, 1968
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to industrial employment in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes rules for standing orders covering topics such as classification of workmen, wages, leave, termination, and penalties.

name: The West Pakistan Land Revenue (Baln. Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1977 , 1977

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Land Revenue (Balochistan Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967 specifically for its application to the Province of Balochistan. It adds a proviso to section 70(1)(b) of the amended Act regarding special assessments with retrospective effect.

name: The West Pakistan Maternity Benefit Ordinance, 1958 , 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Maternity Benefit Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law relating to the employment of women in establishments within the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes rights for maternity benefits, prohibits employment during specific periods surrounding childbirth, and outlines procedures for payment and penalties for contravention.

name: The West Pakistan Railway Servants Welfare Fund Ordinance,1969 , 1969

metadata.title: The Pakistan Railway Servants' Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Welfare Fund to provide relief and security for Railway servants and their families. It outlines the constitution of Welfare Committees, the arrangement with insurance companies, and the rules regarding contributions and fund utilization.

name: The West Paksitan Land Revenue Baln Amendment Ordinance 1977 , 1977

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Land Revenue (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967 specifically for its application to the Province of Balochistan. It introduces new definitions for irrigated and unirrigated land, inserts provisions for information gathering powers, grants exemptions from land revenue for small holdings, and establishes enhanced tax rates for larger landowners.

name: The Whipping (West Pakistan) Amendment Ordinance, 1963 , 1963

metadata.title: The Whipping (West Pakistan) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: The Whipping Act, 1909
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Whipping Act, 1909 to apply specific provisions regarding whipping as punishment for certain offences within West Pakistan. It inserts new sections defining offences punishable by whipping and amends existing sections to omit or reletter clauses.

name: The Whipping West Pakistan Amendment Ordinance, 1969 , 1969

metadata.title: The Whipping (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.amends: The Whipping Act, 1909
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Whipping Act, 1909 as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. It substitutes specific sections regarding punishments for assault, hurt, rape, and other offences, and adds new clauses concerning cattle-related crimes.

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Balochistan Public Finance Management Act, 2020 by substituting the word 'two' with 'three' in section 16(1). It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on June 9, 2023, and assented to by the Governor on June 12, 2023.

name: The Balochistan Right to Information Act, 2021 , 2021

metadata.title: The Balochistan Right to Information Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act ensures transparency and access to information for citizens within Balochistan, subject to reasonable restrictions. It establishes the right of every citizen to access information in matters of public importance to participate meaningfully in the democratic process.

name: The Balochistan Sea Fisheries (Amendment) Act, 2022 , 2022

metadata.title: The Balochistan Sea Fisheries (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Balochistan Sea Fisheries Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Balochistan Sea Fisheries Ordinance, 1971 to further its provisions. It establishes a new section defining the Fisheries Patrolling Staff as a weapons-carrying force for patrolling territorial waters and onshore areas.

name: The Balochistan Shops and Establishments (Amendment) Act, 2022 , 2022

metadata.title: The Balochistan Shops and Establishments (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Balochistan Shops and Establishments Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Balochistan Shops and Establishments Act, 2021 to remove ambiguities and facilitate enforcement. It specifically updates section 28 regarding registration fees and substitutes figures in the Schedule and various forms.

name: The Balochistan Sugarcane (Sale, Purchase and Usage in Factories) Act,2022 , 2022

metadata.title: The Balochistan Sugarcane (Sale, Purchase and Usage in Factories) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the price of sugarcane intended for use in sugar factories within Balochistan. It also governs the sale and purchase of sugarcane by growers and factory owners, as well as the granting of licenses to such factories.

name: The Balochistan Use of Plastic Shoping and Flat Bags Act, 2023 , 2023

metadata.title: The Balochistan Use of Plastic Shopping and Flat Bags Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the manufacturing, sale, purchase, storage, display, use, and import of plastic shopping and flat bags in Balochistan. It establishes definitions for key terms such as 'Plastic', 'Authorized Officer', and 'Extended Producer's Responsibility' to enforce environmental standards.

name: The Balochistan Waqf Properties Act, 2020 , 2020

metadata.title: The Balochistan Waqf Properties Act, 2020
metadata.repeals: existing Waqf properties ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the proper management and administration of Waqf properties in the Balochistan Province. It also repeals the existing Waqf Properties Ordinance, 1979.

name: The Bibi Asmat Malik Memorial Hospital Khudabadan, Panjgur Act,2022 , 2022

metadata.title: The Bibi Asmat Malik Memorial Hospital Khudabadan, Panjgur Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Bibi Asmat Malik Memorial Hospital Khudabadan in Panjgur to provide secondary health care facilities to the local population. It creates a corporate body with perpetual succession and defines the composition, powers, and functions of the Board of Governors responsible for managing the hospital.

name: The Bolan University of Medical and Health Sciences (Amendment) 2020 , 2020

metadata.title: The Bolan University of Medical and Health Sciences (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.amends: The Bolan University of Medical and Health Sciences Act, 2017
metadata.repeals: The Bolan University of Medical and Health Sciences Ordinance, 2007
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Bolan University of Medical and Health Sciences Act, 2017 to restructure constituent colleges, clarify property ownership, and define fund management. It also repeals the previous Ordinance from 2007 that governed the university.

name: The Provincial Insolvency Act, 1920 , 1920

metadata.title: The Provincial Insolvency Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to insolvency in British India, specifically for courts outside the Presidency-towns and Rangoon. It establishes the constitution of courts, procedures for petitions and adjudication, administration of estates, and penalties for insolvents.

name: The Regulation of Mines and Oil fields and Mineral Development (Gov Control)(Amendment) Act,2022 , 2022

metadata.title: The Regulation of Mines and Oilfields and Mineral Development (Government Control) (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Regulation of Mines and Oilfields and Mineral Development (Government Control) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Regulation of Mines and Oilfields and Mineral Development (Government Control) Act, 1948 to introduce provisions for negotiated agreements. It grants the Provincial Government the power to enter into commercial agreements without public tendering for mineral exploration and development in cases involving international obligations.

name: The Shaheed Nawabzada Sikandar Jan Zehri Memorial Hospital Act,2022 , 2022

metadata.title: The Shaheed Nawabzada Sikandar Jan Zehri Memorial Hospital Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Shaheed Nawabzada Sikandar Jan Zehri Memorial Hospital at Zehri to provide modern medical and health care facilities. It defines the hospital as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines the composition, powers, and functions of its Board of Governors.

name: The Ziarat Valley Development Authority Act, 2023 , 2023

metadata.title: The Ziarat Valley Development Authority Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Ziarat Valley Development Authority to oversee the development and improvement of the Ziarat Valley and adjoining areas. Its primary objectives include promoting tourism, conserving forests, executing development plans, and uplifting Ziarat Town as a tourist destination.

name: The Balochistan Mines and Minerals Act , 2025

metadata.title: The Balochistan Mines and Minerals Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes an efficient and transparent administrative, legal, and fiscal framework to support domestic and foreign investment in the mining and minerals sector of Balochistan. It aims to create a stable environment consistent with frameworks in other provinces of Pakistan while excluding specific resources like nuclear energy materials, mineral oil, and natural gas from its application.
