metadata.title: Baluchistan Civil Disputes (Shariat Application) Regulation, 1976
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies the West Pakistan Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1962 to the Tribal Areas of Baluchistan. It establishes specific courts, namely Courts of Qazi and Majalis-e-Shura, for adjudicating civil disputes among Muslims in these areas according to Shariat Law.

name: The Balochistan Public Service Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026 , 2026

metadata.title: Balochistan Public Service Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026
metadata.amends: Balochistan Public Service Commission Act, 1989
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Balochistan Public Service Commission Act, 1989 to allow a former chairman to be re-appointed for one further term after their initial term expires. The amendment limits this re-appointment to a single additional term not exceeding three years.

name: Balochistan Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education Employees Service Regulation, 2019 , 2019

metadata.summary: These regulations establish the terms and conditions of service for employees of the Balochistan Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education. They define eligibility criteria, appointment authorities, age limits, qualifications, and probationary periods for various classes of staff.

metadata.title: The Balochistan Zakat and Ushr (Repeal) Ordinance, 2026
metadata.repeals: The Balochistan Zakat and Ushr Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Balochistan Zakat and Ushr Act, 2012. It transfers the administration of Zakat and Ushr matters to the Board of Revenue Department and consolidates Zakat funds into a new dedicated fund managed by the Social Welfare and Human Rights Department.

name: The Balochistan Safe City Authority Ordinance, 2026 , 2026

metadata.title: The Balochistan Safe Cities Authority Ordinance, 2026
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Balochistan Safe Cities Authority (BSCA) to construct, develop, and maintain a city-wide integrated command, control, and communications system. The Authority is tasked with ensuring the safety and security of lives and properties in major cities of the Province of Balochistan, specifically starting with Quetta.

name: The Balochistan Restrictions of Rented Building (Security) Act , 2015

metadata.summary: This Act establishes a mechanism to monitor rented buildings in Balochistan for the purpose of counter-terrorism and crime prevention. It mandates written rent agreements with verified tenant credentials, requires landlords to submit specific information to police officers within three days of signing an agreement, and grants police powers to inspect such properties.

name: The Balochistan Residential Colleges Act , 2005

metadata.title: The Balochistan Residential Colleges Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of Residential Colleges in Balochistan to promote education. It establishes a Board of Governors with specific powers to manage college affairs, appoint staff, and formulate budgets.

name: The Balochistan Revenue Authority Act , 2015

metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Balochistan Safe Blood Transfusion Authority to regulate the transfusion of safe and healthy blood in the province. name: The Balochistan Seized and Freezed Institutions (Masajid) Act , 2020

metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Masajid Management Board in Balochistan to manage seized and frozen educational or training institutions. name: The Balochistan Senior Citizens Act , 2017

metadata.title: The Balochistan Senior Citizens Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the well-being, comfort, and other benefits to senior citizens in Balochistan. It establishes a Senior Citizens Welfare Council to oversee welfare packages and social security grants.

name: The Balochistan Shops And Establishment (Security) Act , 2009

metadata.title: The Balochistan Shops and Establishments (Security) Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the security of shops and establishments in Balochistan, along with related matters. It empowers the Government to regulate measures for protecting property and persons connected with an establishment and outlines penalties for contravention.

name: The Balochistan Service Tribunals Act , 1974

metadata.title: The Baluchistan Service Tribunals Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Service Tribunals in Balochistan to exercise exclusive jurisdiction over matters relating to the terms and conditions of service for civil servants. metadata.title: The Baluchistan Students Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Students Welfare Fund for the students of the Province of Baluchistan. It creates a Student Welfare Board to manage the fund and provide financial aid, particularly for medical treatment and sports, to students in distress.

metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salaries, allowances, and privileges of the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of Baluchistan. metadata.title: The Balochistan Subordinate Judiciary Service Tribunal Act, 1989
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Service Tribunal for the Province of Balochistan to exercise exclusive jurisdiction over matters regarding the terms and conditions of service for members of the subordinate judiciary. metadata.summary: This Ordinance abolishes the system of Sardari in Baluchistan, which is described as a remnant of an oppressive feudal and tribal system. It prohibits recognized Sardars from exercising unauthorized judicial powers, maintaining private jails, arresting individuals without legal cause, or demanding tribute and forced labor.

metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1958 as it applies to the province of Baluchistan. It introduces new cinema classes with specific tax percentages in both Part 'A' and Part 'B' of the relevant Schedule.

name: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty (Balochistan Second Amendment) Ordinance,1978 , 1978

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty (Baluchistan Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1958 as it applies to the Province of Baluchistan. It substitutes a specific subsection regarding the commencement date of the previous amendment ordinance with a provision allowing the Government to appoint a future date via notification.

name: The West Pakistan Family Courts (Balochistan Amendment) Act , 2005

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Family Courts (Balochistan Amendment) Act, 2005
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Family Courts Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Family Courts Act, 1964 to apply specifically to the Province of Balochistan. It introduces provisions for the transfer of cases between family courts and districts by the High Court or District Court, as well as powers to stay proceedings.

name: The West Pakistan Family Courts (Balochistan Amendment) Act, 2005 , 2005

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Family Courts (Balochistan Amendment) Act, 2005
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Family Courts Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Family Courts Act, 1964 to apply specifically to the Province of Balochistan. It introduces provisions for the transfer of cases between family courts and districts by the High Court or District Courts, as well as powers to stay proceedings.

name: The West Pakistan Finance (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1978.pdf , 1978

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance (Baluchistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Finance Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the West Pakistan Finance Ordinance, 1969 as it applies to the Province of Baluchistan. Specifically, it substitutes the amount 'Twenty Paisa' for 'Ten Paisa' in Section 8(1)(i) of the amended ordinance.

name: The West Pakistan Finance Act (Balochistan Amendment) Act , 1974

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Act (Baluchistan Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Finance Act, 1964 to apply its provisions to the Province of Baluchistan. It substitutes new Fifth and Sixth Schedules that define specific rates for electricity duty and list exemptions from such duty.

name: The West Pakistan Land Revenue (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1976.pdf , 1976

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Land Revenue (Baluchistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.amends: The Baluchistan Land Revenue Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Baluchistan Land Revenue Act, 1967 to further regulate land revenue in the Province of Baluchistan. It introduces new definitions for irrigated and unirrigated land, inserts provisions regarding land ownership information requests, exempts certain small landowners from specific revenue charges, and establishes enhanced land revenue rates for larger holdings starting from Rabi 1975-76.

name: The West Pakistan Land Revenue (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1977.pdf , 1977

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Land Revenue (Baluchistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.amends: The Baluchistan Land Revenue Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Baluchistan Land Revenue Act, 1967 to introduce new definitions for irrigated and unirrigated land. It establishes exemptions from land revenue for owners of small plots and mandates increased revenue rates for owners of larger holdings.

name: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Balochistan Amendment) Act , 1974

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Baluchistan Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Baluchistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965, to apply its provisions to the Province of Baluchistan. It specifically updates references regarding insurance authorities and compensation scales within the principal Ordinance.

name: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance. 1978 .pdf , 1978

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Baluchistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the sixth Schedule of the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 as it applies to the Province of Baluchistan. It inserts specific locations into the schedule and adds corresponding letter codes in the second column.

name: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1979 .pdf , 1979

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Baluchistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the application of the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965, to Baluchistan. It updates specific terms related to transport authorities and insurance companies within the relevant sections and schedules.

name: The West Pakistan Press And Publications (Balochistan Amendment) Act , 1974

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Press and Publications (Baluchistan Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Press and Publications Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Press and Publications Ordinance, 1963 to apply it to the Province of Baluchistan. It specifically inserts a new sub-section into Section 59 to punish individuals who make, print, sell, or distribute publications described in clause (f) of section 24 with imprisonment up to six months, a fine up to one thousand rupees, or both.

name: Thw Balochistan Local Government (Amendment) Act , 2004

metadata.title: The Balochistan Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.amends: The Balochistan Local Government Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Balochistan Local Government Ordinance, 2001 by substituting the word 'four' for 'three' in specific subsections of sections 150 and 159. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on August 13, 2004, and assented to by the Governor on the same date.

name: University of Balochistan (Amendment) Ordinance. 2001.pdf , 2001

metadata.title: University of Balochistan (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.amends: University of Balochistan Act, 1996
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the University of Balochistan Act, 1996 to introduce the position of Pro-Vice Chancellor. It defines the appointment process, duties, and powers of the Pro-Vice Chancellor, including acting in the absence of the Vice Chancellor.

name: West Pakistan Tandoo Leaves (Prohibition On Possession And Use) (Balochistan Repeal) , 1974

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Tandoo Leaves (Prohibition On Possession And Use) (Baluchistan Repeal) Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Tandoo Leaves (Prohibition On Possession And Use) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the application of the West Pakistan Tandoo Leaves (Prohibition On Possession And Use) Ordinance, 1966 to the Province of Baluchistan. It also repeals a specific Baluchistan ordinance enacted in 1974 regarding the same subject matter.

name: The Ziarat Valley Development Authority Act , 1992

metadata.title: The Ziarat Valley Development Authority Act, 1992
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Ziarat Valley Development Authority to oversee the development and improvement of specific areas in the Ziarat Valley and adjoining regions. The Authority is empowered to implement schemes for education, health, agriculture, tourism, and infrastructure, while also managing government agencies within its jurisdiction.

name: بلوچستان قومی رضا کار ضابطہ، 1965 , 1965

metadata.title: Balochistan National Volunteers Ordinance, 1965
metadata.amends: Balochistan National Volunteer Code 1965
metadata.repeals: Balochistan Code 1985
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prescribes laws relating to the National Volunteers in the Province of Balochistan. It establishes their duties, powers, and protections while providing for their formation, training, and assistance to police forces.

name: بلوچستان مالیاتی (ترمیمی) آرڈیننس، 1981 , 1981

metadata.title: Balochistan Financial (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.amends: Balochistan Financial Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Balochistan Financial Ordinance, 1981 by substituting and inserting sections related to its application and specific provisions. It was promulgated by the Governor of Balochistan under Article 123 of the Constitution and came into force immediately.

name: بلوچستان مقامی کونسل کے ذیلی قوانین بابتِ رجسٹریشن پیدائش و اموات ایکٹ , 2020

metadata.title: The Birth and Death Rules
metadata.amends: Birth and Death Registration Rules 2020
metadata.summary: This notification approves and issues the Birth and Death Rules for public information under the Balochistan Local Government Act 2020. The rules apply to all local municipal and urban development councils throughout the province of Balochistan.

name: بلوچستان میں دہشت گردی کا شکار شہریوں کے (ریلیف و بحالی کا ایکٹ مجریہ، 2014 , 2014

metadata.title: The Victims of Terrorism in Balochistan (Relief and Rehabilitation) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes an institutional framework to address the difficulties faced by victims of terrorism and their families in Balochistan. It provides for immediate relief, recognition of rights to public assistance, and the formation of a commission to analyze losses suffered by citizens due to terrorist incidents.

name: ضابطہ دیوانی( مغربی پاکستان ترمیمی) ایکٹ، 1963 , 1963

metadata.title: Code of Civil Procedure (West Pakistan Amendment) Act 1963
metadata.amends: Code of Civil Procedure 1898
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Civil Procedure 1898 to apply specifically to the Province of West Pakistan. It introduces a new provision requiring courts to order compensation payments to the heirs of deceased victims or persons suffering bodily hurt/property damage in cases involving specific criminal offences like murder, robbery, and dacoity.

name: قومی آفات(انسداد اور دادرسی ایکٹ) (توسیع قبائلی علاقوں) ضابطہ، 1963 , 1963

metadata.title: The Balochistan (Suppression of Tribal Violence Act) (Extension to Tribal Areas) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: The Balochistan (Suppression of Tribal Violence Act), 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends the Balochistan (Suppression of Tribal Violence Act), 1958, to the Tribal Areas of Dera Ismail Khan, Peshawar, and Dera. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan in his capacity as the Approving Authority for reasons of public convenience.

name: مجموعہ تعزایرات (مغربی پاکستان ترمیمی) ایکٹ، 1963 , 1963

metadata.title: Pakistan Penal Code (West Pakistan Amendment) Act 1973
metadata.amends: Pakistan Penal Code
metadata.summary: This Act serves as an amendment to the Pakistan Penal Code specifically for the Province of West Pakistan. It includes provisions to modify specific sections of the penal code, such as Section 1303.

name: مغربی پاکستان کا غذائی ایشیاء ( کنٹرول ) ایکٹ، 1971 , 1971

metadata.title: West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Act, 1958 (Application in Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1971
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This regulation applies the provisions of the West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Act, 1958 to specific tribal areas within the Province of Balochistan. It includes orders and notifications issued under that Act and defines the extent of its application to districts such as Chagai and Thob.

name: کواپریٹیو سوسائٹیز ( مغربی پاکستان ترمیم )آرڈیننس، 1965 , 1965

metadata.title: Sindh Cooperative Societies (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.amends: Sindh Cooperative Societies Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the Sindh Cooperative Societies Act, 1925 to replace references to 'Sindh' with 'Province of West Pakistan' and other related terms. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan on April 27, 1965, due to the Provincial Assembly not being in session.

name: یوم یادگار (بلوچستان) ایکٹ، 1964 , 1964

metadata.title: Pakistan Memorial Balochistan Acquisition Act 1964
metadata.amends: Pakistan Memorial Tax (Balochistan) Act 1964
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the collection of funds to support the Pakistan Memorial within the province of Balochistan. It establishes a committee to manage these funds and outlines the methods for tax levies on residential houses and rural areas.

name: Corporate Social Resposibility (CSR) Guidlines, 2025 , 2025

metadata.title: Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Guidelines 2025
metadata.summary: These guidelines establish a transparent and accountable framework for planning, implementing, and monitoring Corporate Social Responsibility initiatives within the Government of Balochistan. They aim to align contributions from public and private entities with provincial development priorities in sectors such as education, healthcare, and environmental protection.

name: The Balochistan Clinical Laboratory Regulatory Rules, 2005 , 2005

metadata.title: Balochistan Clinical Laboratory Regulatory Rules, 2005
metadata.summary: These rules establish the regulatory framework for clinical laboratories in Balochistan, defining terms related to accreditation, licensing, and personnel qualifications. They mandate that all clinical tests be conducted by duly licensed and accredited laboratories supervised by qualified pathologists.

name: Government of Balochistan Cloud Policy, 2024 , 2024

metadata.title: Cloud First Policy
metadata.summary: This notification approves and publishes the Cloud First Policy for the Government of Balochistan, containing nineteen pages. The policy aims to streamline IT procurement, attract digital investments, and transition government departments from siloed on-premises infrastructure to cloud-based solutions.

name: Clg, H&T Edu Department, (Tech Wing) Tech Subordinates (Womens Section) (BPS-1 to 15) , 2022

metadata.title: The Balochistan Colleges, Higher and Technical Education Department, (Technical Wing) Technical Subordinates (Women's Section) (BPS-1 to 15) Service Rules, 2022
metadata.summary: These rules regulate the recruitment to the Balochistan Colleges, Higher and Technical Education Department (Technical Wing) for Technical Subordinates in the Women's Section. They prescribe conditions of service, eligibility criteria, age limits, qualifications, and appointing authorities for posts ranging from BPS-1 to BPS-15.

name: Clg, H&T Edu Deptt (T. Wing) Ministerial Subordinates (Men`s Section) (BPS-1 to 15) S.R, 2022 , 2022

metadata.title: The Balochistan Colleges, Higher and Technical Education Department, (Technical Wing) Ministerial Subordinates (Men's Section) (BPS-1 to 15) Service Rules, 2022
metadata.summary: These rules regulate the recruitment to the Balochistan Colleges, Higher and Technical Education Department (Technical Wing) Ministerial Subordinates Service. They prescribe conditions of service for persons appointed to posts ranging from BPS-1 to BPS-15 within the specified department.

name: Irrigation Department Civil Engineers (BPS-16 and Above) Service Rules , 2022

metadata.title: The Balochistan Irrigation Department Civil Engineers (BPS-16 and above) Service Rules, 2022
metadata.summary: These rules regulate the recruitment to the Balochistan Irrigation Department Civil Engineers (BPS-16 and above) Service. They also prescribe the conditions of service for persons appointed to this service, including eligibility criteria, age limits, and probation periods.

name: The Balochistan Civil Servants Pension Rules, 1989 , 1989

metadata.title: The Balochistan Civil Servants Pension Rules, 1989
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for granting pensions and gratuities to government servants in Balochistan. They define eligibility conditions, application procedures, and specific exclusions for certain categories of employees.

name: The Balochistan Educational Institute Food Standard Rules, 2022 , 2022

metadata.title: The Balochistan Educational Institutions Food Standard Rules, 2022
metadata.summary: These rules establish food standards for canteens and vendors within educational institutions in Balochistan to ensure cost-effective, hygienic, and nutritious meals for students. They categorize food into green, yellow, and red labels based on nutritional value and restrict the sale of 'Red Labeled Food' while promoting 'Green Labeled Food'. The regulations also mandate hygiene practices, staff training, and the formation of monitoring committees to enforce compliance.

name: The Balochistan Finance and Accounts Group Service Rules, 2001 , 2001

metadata.title: Balochistan Finance and Accounts Group Service Rules, 2001
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the conditions of service for persons appointed to the Balochistan Finance and Accounts Group Service. They establish eligibility criteria, recruitment methods, age limits, and probationary periods for members of the service.

name: The Balochistan Food Authority (Appeal) Rules, 2022 , 2022

metadata.title: The Balochistan Food Authority (Appeal) Rules, 2022
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedure for filing appeals before the Appellate Authority of the Balochistan Food Authority under the Balochistan Food Authority Act, 2014. They define key terms, specify fees and timelines for submitting appeals, outline the hearing process, and detail consequences for contravening final orders.

name: The Balochistan Letter of Administration and Succession Certificates Rules, 2022 , 2022

metadata.title: Balochistan Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates Rules, 2022
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the procedure for applying for Letters of Administration or Succession Certificates in Balochistan. They define key terms, outline the required documentation and evidence, establish processes for public notice and verification, and set guidelines for issuing duplicate or amended certificates along with associated fees.

name: The Balochistan Planning and Economics Group Service Rules, 2001 , 2001

metadata.title: Balochistan Planning and Economics Group Service Rules, 2001
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe conditions of service for persons appointed to the Balochistan Planning and Economics Group Service. They establish eligibility criteria, recruitment methods, age limits, and probationary periods for members of the service.

name: The Bln Food (I Notice, P Orders and E Prohibition Orders) Rules, 2022 , 2022

metadata.title: The Balochistan Food (Improvement Notice, Prohibition Orders and Emergency Prohibition Orders) Rules, 2022
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Balochistan Food Authority under section 56 of the Balochistan Food Authority Act, 2014. They define key terms such as 'Food Safety Hazard' and outline procedures for issuing Improvement Notices to rectify discrepancies in food operations without immediate health risks.

name: The Revised Teaching Staff (BPS-09 to 15) Recruitment Policy, 2019 , 2019

metadata.title: The Revised Teaching Staff (BPS-09 to 15) Recruitment Policy (2019) Secondary Education
metadata.summary: This notification establishes a revised recruitment policy for secondary education teaching staff in Balochistan, effective immediately. It outlines the vision for merit-based, transparent hiring to address human resource shortages and ensures equal opportunity through specific guidelines on vacancy advertisements, age limits, and qualification requirements.

name: The Balochistan (Traffic Engineering) Act , 2022

metadata.title: The Balochistan (Traffic Engineering) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Balochistan Transport Board to formulate policies and resolve matters related to transport and traffic in the province. It also defines various terms regarding vehicles, roads, and parking to promote road safety and convenient use of roads.

name: The Balochistan Fertilizer Control Act , 2022

metadata.title: The Balochistan Fertilizer Control Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the manufacture, sale, and distribution of fertilizers within the Balochistan Province. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly on February 22, 2022, and received assent from the Governor on March 7, 2022.

name: The Balochistan Constabulary Act, 1975 , 1975

metadata.title: The Baluchistan Constabulary Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of the Baluchistan Constabulary and matters connected therewith. It establishes the force under the Federal Government for protecting external frontiers within or adjoining Baluchistan.
